### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A08 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A08`.

**Outcome:** Resolve Stop from the submission captured at tap time; separate durable answer receipt from live continuation.

**Owner:** Agent Service interaction owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Resolve Stop from the submission captured at tap time; separate durable answer receipt from live continuation, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py::SQLiteSessionRepository.cancel_turn; respond_to_interaction` into `server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py; server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py; server/agent_service/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py; server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py; server/agent_service/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py) — `SQLiteSessionRepository.cancel_turn; respond_to_interaction`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/execution.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/execution.py) — `stop, answer`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py) — `interaction records`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/harness-run-control.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/harness-run-control.md) — `Durable question and answer receipt`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- A continues, B retained, C proceeds
- Question-keyed answers and card IDs
- Committed success wins when already authoritative

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Rerouting Stop by proximity
- Stopping all active tasks
- Ordinary questions treated as approval

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py
- server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py
- server/agent_service/proxy.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a08.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-M16](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/786), [DM31-M17](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/787), [DM31-A17](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/792)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-A10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/760), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Supplement needs A20; question receipt is not supplement consumption

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Delayed route/receipt Stop affects only B while A/C continue
- Duplicate answer resumes once; wrong Q/R rejects
- Reopened receipt without live owner does not fabricate continuation

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a08

**Cases:** - A/B/C public barriers
- One-to-four answers and lost acknowledgement
- Failed Stop write retains revocation fence

**Participants:** Real backend controls/Manager/Store with file-backed SQLite; scripted live wait and controlled provider; barriers around delayed admission, receipt, Stop and final commit.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, controls. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0005, host-operation-lifecycle.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Background and Goal Description

<!-- DM31:MASTER -->

<!-- DM31:IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF -->

**Implementation entry point:** [Read the English implementation handoff](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/implementation-handoff.md). The assigned implementation agent should follow its autonomous contract-first workflow: verify and merge contracts and gates, prove compliance through a real consumer PR, then expand dependent development. Isolate genuine blockers in issues and continue eligible work without requesting routine maintainer decisions. This is the subsequent implementation phase; the original survey remains planning evidence, not an implementation pass.

<!-- /DM31:IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF -->

Deliver the **production v3.1 server refactor from main**, preserving main's supported product behavior while making the accepted component contracts, state ownership and default deployment real. This is the formal implementation task graph, not a claim that migration code, tests, deployment or feature parity already exists.

**Frozen survey:** main `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`; architecture reference `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`, sampled from remote HEAD at the start on 2026-11-07. Main advanced from supplied `077c4eab` only through the UserManagementPage back-button/layout change; that client change is included. The architecture checkout's local `aab978c4` was not substituted for the frozen reference. Subsequent implementation starts from current main and reconciles its delta without rewriting the survey.

**Authority:** frozen ADR-0001–0010, [boundaries](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/boundaries.md), [Host lifecycle](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md), [general capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md), [run controls](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/harness-run-control.md) and v3.1 diagram sources. Authority classes: **A** accepted behavior/boundaries; **B** actual frozen-main enabled or supported configured behavior; **C** candidate implementation/verification with exact scope; **D** accepted but not delivered; **E** proposed strategy. Candidate code and old test counts do not promote C/E into A or completed main work. Orbit materials are external evidence; DM ADRs authorize the general capabilities.

**Non-goals:** no architecture-foundation merge, validation-tree wholesale copy, opaque old daemon behind a proxy, unrelated phone rewrite, new ADX/login/sandbox platform, externally independent execution authority, automatic product implementation/deployment, development-trigger labels, repository freeze or permanent legacy allowlist. Cleanup is bonus-only with reachability/configuration/equivalent-replacement evidence.

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

**Research and coverage entry points (English):**

- [Frozen baseline, all-issue/PR search disposition and dedup](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/baseline-and-dedup.md)
- [Actual main entries, configuration, deep I/O and tests](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md)
- [Complete product-action coverage and dispositions](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/action-coverage.md)
- [Source/capability → migration issue → acceptance matrix](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/coverage-matrix.md)
- [Accepted versus candidate evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md)
- [Architecture rule → authority → legal/illegal fixture → CI → owner matrix and production acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md)
- [Decision register](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/decisions.md), [developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md), [independent planning review](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/review.md)

**Existing work reused, not duplicated or silently changed:** #571 E1–E3 assertions, #565 E4–E6 corpus/evidence and #500 cleanup remain open shared work; consume their actual delivered portions and preserve pending status. #698/PR #699 workspace-binding defect/fix is an integration input, not asserted merged. #311 existing isolation report remains separate. #505/PR #509 is an older modularization plan, not this accepted authority/deletion/base policy. #324/PR #323 is provenance history; PR #588 is optional-dependency work to reconcile. #570 failure-protocol and #271 Orbit integration remain their own proposals; no phone rewrite or Orbit product scope is imported. New issues below cover the main migration, not those existing projects.

**Batch and concurrency rules:** phases are integration milestones, not all-to-all barriers. P0 delivers inventory/public contracts, real legal/illegal scanner fixtures, trusted early CI, CODEOWNERS/enforcement plan and old-branch development guidance. P1 forms the genuine unchanged-client CHAT-01/02 vertical. P2 extracts capability modules; P3 closes policy/accounting/control/recovery; these overlap when named hard prerequisites permit. P4 is independent integrated acceptance.

Parallel sets after contracts: model transport / plugin dispatch / identity / ownership scanner; then skill mapping / source search / artifacts / media fixtures / conditional providers; then independent QA preparation and separate A/B case groups under an exclusive device lease. The graph and each issue's writable files govern actual scheduling; examples do not permit shared-file edits.

**Single-owner serial lanes:** A01 public identity/error types; A14 shared hook/attempt/reservation types; Store owner serializes A02→A03, then the ready A08/A12/A15/A29/A30/A17/M18 persistence changes in dependency order with one schema merge at a time; Host lifecycle owner serializes A06/A07/A08 and subsequent A26/A23 enforcement changes. The arrow here expresses ownership sequencing, not permission to skip prerequisites. Other module extraction and tests proceed independently. G01 records named maintainers; role labels below do not invent GitHub assignees.

**Critical paths:** identity/contracts → Store admission/context → Manager/Registry/Host/backend → Runtime/Router + normal factory/model/tool adapters → G07/Q03 → unchanged CHAT-01/02. Checkpoint and same-S decisions run early and gate only their dependent adapter/persistence/control activation. Full acceptance additionally requires child/deep I/O, supported conditional business paths, production accounting/inspect, format/old-writer guard, A/B corpus and independent verdict. A compatible format guard blocks new-format traffic, not unrelated extraction work.

**Per-task migration completion requires:** default production calls transferred to the named owner; old entry deleted or public-proxy-only delegate; no duplicate authority/dual write/silent fallback; bypass/reconnection mutants fail gates; developer extension interface, owner and exact test command documented. A contract, investigation or QA issue instead delivers its explicitly stated artifact and never claims a production switch.

| [DM31-M29](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/742) — Freeze the action-to-owner coverage inventory before cutover | P0: contracts, inventory and early gates | Architecture and product API | none | Open; planned, not implemented |

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象：** 在对话里**直接粘贴图片**（不是发附件链接、也不是给文件路径）后，助手气泡只回一句英文 `The source is private to a different audience`，图片没有被解析成任何可读内容，也无法基于图片内容作答。

**复现步骤：**
1. 打开 DigitalMate 对话（web 渠道）。
2. 直接在输入框粘贴一张图片（例如 image_1794018912951.png），不附带文件路径。
3. 发送后观察助手回复。

**预期：** 同一会话内粘贴的图片应可被读取并用于回答；若暂不支持识图，应给出**中文、可理解**的能力提示（如「当前对话暂不支持直接识图，请改用文件方式」），而不是抛出内部 `PermissionError` 原文。

**实际：** 图片内容完全不可读，只回显 `The source is private to a different audience`。该报错容易被误解为用户贴错/图损坏，实际是本端把贴进来的图当作「当前会话无权访问的私有来源」挡在门外。

```text
The source is private to a different audience
```

**判断（可能根因，与历史单一致）：** 与 #453 同源——上传/落地成 Source 时 `allowed_actor_ids` 只写 `[principal_id]`，而 `source_visible_in_room` 要求 `people_in_room ⊆ allowed_actor_ids`；房间里有其他成员时校验失败，组 brief 时抛出该 `PermissionError` 并原文进气泡。修复 PR #462（把 room uploads 的 audience 设为 `room.member_ids`）目前仍为 open，未见合入/上线，故线上仍复现。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：DigitalMate 对话应用（digitalmate）
- 渠道：web
- 时间：2026-11-07 10:30–10:42（Asia/Shanghai），多轮贴图均可复现
- 输入方式：直接在对话中粘贴图片（非文件路径）
- 涉及图片示例：image_1794018912951.png
- 浏览器/系统：未单独记录，可后续补充

### Additional Information

- 关联历史单：#453（[Bug]: v0.1.6 发附件报 The source is private to a different audience）、修复 #462（fix(server): give room uploads the room audience (#453)，当前仍 open）。本单强调「直接粘贴图片」这条路径，且报错文案对用户有误导性。
- 建议：（1）附件/贴图路径保证同房间可读（合入 #462 思路）；（2）客户端把该错误映射为中文可理解提示，禁止内部 `PermissionError` 原文进气泡（关联 #359）；（3）短期若无法识图，贴图时直接给可操作引导。

### Version Information

- 仓库 main 分支对应版本；线上为当前部署构建（具体版本号待补）。历史同错见 v0.1.6（#453）。

### Screenshots / Recordings

- 该问题正是「贴图本身无法被读入」，故本端拿不到图片字节、无法自动附上截图；报错原文已在上方代码块给出。如需要可视证据，可请复现同学在客户端截图补充。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:Q02 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-Q02`.

**Outcome:** Same HAP/driver/assertions/cases/model conditions compare main and candidate; all 36 current cases have explicit disposition.

**Owner:** Independent QA coordinator. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No duplicate #571 or #565 driver/assertion work
- Do not use historical 23 cases as current full set
- Manifest/fixture preparation needs no device lease; installation/execution requires Q01. Strict historical 7c official build and alternate compilation are separate evidence classes, not interchangeable A/B identities.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json::version registry` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tests/e2e/workflow/migration/main-baseline-manifest.json; tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json) — `version registry`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/case-identity.mjs](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/case-identity.mjs) — `case identity module`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md) — `Version and build receipts`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing case IDs, versions, tier/lane/stability semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Changing assertions or client messages only for candidate

**Writable boundary:**
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/main-baseline-manifest.json
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.test.mjs

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** None; may start from the frozen evidence.

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/772)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738), [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- HAP SHA and install receipts match on both sides
- Freeze driver, cases, catalog, calibration, model and config identities
- Include disabled-by-default cases explicitly
- Existing todo controller capability remains BLOCKED on original issue
- Main advances trigger updated A and affected paired reruns
- run-ab invokes the existing run-workflow per explicit case; compare A/B manifests and reject changed HAP/driver/assertion hashes. Fixture tests prove only backend identity may differ. No mutation to case assertions or phone protocol.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Checks:** - Existing case/catalog/provenance validators
- Compare A/B manifest allowing only endpoint/profile/deployment identities to differ

**Participants:** Independent QA, same frozen HAP and original driver/assertions; actual old/new backend builds. Controlled input/fault fixture is named per case; it cannot replace actual phone or new production owner. Exclusive resource lease needed for execution.

**Evidence:** A/B backend identity and M/S/R/Host/Store trace; PASS/FAIL/environment-BLOCKED/NOT-RUN separately; retain baseline failures.

**Commands:** - node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --list
- node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --validate
- node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**

- Unknown automatically triggers R2
- Fixture cancellation-context policy promoted to accepted norm

**Writable boundary:**
- docs/specs/same-session-controls.md
- docs/adr/0012-same-session-controls-decision.md
- docs/plans/v31-server-migration/check_decisions.py (shared contract-owner review only)

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A29](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/801), [DM31-M37](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/809)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-M29](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/742), [DM31-G01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/743), [DM31-G02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/744)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Decision drafting may proceed independently; the shared check_decisions.py helper has the A01 contract owner and serial edits. Only accepted decisions unlock dependent behavior; unresolved decisions do not block unrelated migration.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - R2 fallback remains proposed
- Choose FIFO/fairness/owner-loss policy
- Decide cancelled B history/context visibility

### Test Verification

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Define durable M-to-owning-R association and consumption evidence
- Truthful public inspection across queue/cancel/questions/restart
- Version receipts and reject collisions/unsupported encodings

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Review:** Review paired state-transition examples, legacy source/ack boundaries and acceptance decision with the named contract/Store/Harness owners. Record accepted/rejected alternatives. No implementation test pass claimed.

**Planned Validator:** python3 docs/plans/v31-server-migration/check_decisions.py --decision A20


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** controls, concurrency. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0005, ADR0009.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate。「发现」负一屏瀑布流体验可用（新闻/视频卡片、底部提示「试试说：多给我推荐点足球内容」）。产品侧需确认：当前流是否已由个人记忆驱动。报告人判断「应该还和个人记忆没关系」——经对照代码后记录为观察/条目标清，非立刻修 bug。

## 测试环境
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-20`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 截图状态栏时间：约 08:13
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 路径：底栏「发现」

## 原图

![发现负一屏](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg)

## 结果
- **实际（体感）：** 发现流为通用信源内容（如医保、时政视频、妈祖等），未见明显由对话个人记忆个性化的证据；更像冷启/探索 + 发现页自有偏好（composer/标签）。
- **代码对照（现状，非实现任务）：**
  - 存在预留 `DiscoveryMemoryProjection`（`entry/.../waterfall/DiscoveryMemoryProjection*.ets`）：可把长期记忆投影为发现偏好信号。
  - 重建门槛：`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 8`，且默认等待约 7 天（`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_WAIT_MS`）——不是装上即读个人记忆。
  - 发现 PES 实验：P（profile）初始为空，经发现 composer/标签填充；新账号先走 E（探索）冷启。与对话「个人记忆」不是同一条即时通路。
- **期望（条目标清）：** 产品文档/验收写明：发现负一屏当前 **不依赖** 个人记忆即可用；若要「记忆 → 发现」接通，另开实现 issue，并写清门槛与验收。

## 验收
- [ ] README / 能力说明写清：发现 ≠ 已接个人记忆（或写明接通条件）
- [ ] 若做接通：有独立验收（记忆事实变更后发现偏好可见、可关、可解释）
- [ ] 本观察不阻塞发现负一屏作为独立体验继续迭代

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate（Orbit 客户端）。用户让 agent「帮我给openjiuwen-ai下面的digitalmate仓库提issue」，agent 弹出「需求收集」卡，要求用户去 github.com/settings/tokens 生成并**在聊天里粘贴 GitHub Token**（勾选 repo），否则无法调用 GitHub API。用户回复「我手机上没有版本找到token」，流程卡住。

## 测试环境
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 场景：在对话中让 agent 代提 GitHub issue
- 时间：约 2026-10-21 12:20–12:21（Asia/Shanghai，截图状态栏）

![要求粘贴 GitHub Token](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-github-token-ask.jpg)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-21-card-pending-banner.jpg)
## 结果
- **实际：** 无应用内 GitHub 连接/OAuth；只能让用户手动创建 PAT 并在聊天中明文粘贴。手机用户基本无法完成，且在聊天中索要原始 token 有安全风险（token 进入对话记录/上下文）。
- **期望：** 提供授权连接流程（OAuth / GitHub App，范围可见、可撤销）；未支持时明确提示「暂不支持」。任何情况下不在聊天中索要原始 PAT。

## 验收
- [ ] 手机端可通过授权流程连接 GitHub 并提 issue，或给出明确的「暂不支持」提示
- [ ] 对话中不再出现索要原始 token 的文案

# 🚀 [Roadmap] 项目核心能力演进与 Demo 演示追踪

> **Issue 类型:** Feature / Roadmap  
> **当前状态:** 持续更新中 (Active)  
> **说明:** 本 Issue 用于统一追踪 Agent 核心能力的开发进度及 Demo 演示状态。按周（Weekly）粒度持续更新，请在完成特性与 Demo 验证后更新对应的复选框。

---

## 📅 每周 Roadmap 与进度追踪

### 📅 10.19 ~ 10.25

- [x] **Bot 主对话与话题自动管理**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **自然语言发起任务：** 用户在 Bot 主对话中直接提出需求，无需手动创建会话、选择 Agent 或 Skill。
    - **话题切换与续接：** 根据输入自动创建或接续话题，支持在多个任务之间切换，并回到已有话题继续交流。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **跨话题连续对话：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 输入“浦东新区的球场呢” $\rightarrow$ 输入“南京有啥好吃的”。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 对话中出现新建或续接话题提示；最后一轮接续“南京三日游行程规划”，返回南京美食建议，内容不与篮球场任务混淆。

- [x] **主动澄清与需求收集**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **主动补全需求：** 面对范围、偏好等信息不完整的请求，Agent 通过交互卡片向用户提问。
    - **反馈驱动执行：** 用户选择并提交回答后，Agent 依据补充条件继续任务，回答记录保留在对话中。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **篮球场需求澄清：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 选择“徐汇/静安一带（推荐）”和“免费室外场” $\rightarrow$ 提交回答 $\rightarrow$ 获取场地推荐。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 卡片支持问题切换和发送回答，提交后显示“已回答”；结果体现所选区域和免费室外偏好，并说明未核实的开放、收费或预约信息。

- [x] **多任务后台执行与进展通知**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **后台持续执行：** 用户切换话题或离开聊天页面后，已发起的任务继续运行。
    - **多入口跟踪：** 通过聊天状态、实时活动面板、负一屏卡片和完成通知查看任务进展与结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **切换页面跟踪任务：** 发起上海篮球场和南京旅游任务 $\rightarrow$ 查看实时活动面板及负一屏卡片 $\rightarrow$ 返回聊天继续询问浦东球场 $\rightarrow$ 查看此前任务的完成通知。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 不同任务分别显示名称、进度和摘要；切换后仍能看到原任务状态更新，完成通知能够对应到具体任务。

- [x] **结构化结果呈现与异常降级**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **结构化交付：** 将复杂需求整理为文字结论、表格、清单和预算，方便用户阅读与继续追问。
    - **异常降级交付：** 当网页获取或交互式产物生成受阻时，说明限制，并提供可用的文字或表格结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **南京旅行规划：** 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 观察执行进度和结果逐步呈现 $\rightarrow$ 查看三日行程表、预约事项及预算。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 行程按天、时间和安排组织，包含一人三天两晚约 1300–1700 元预算；交互式行程板未生成时明确说明，并提供文字行程与清单。

- [x] **Cross-Session Long-Term Memory (跨会话记忆与动态更新)**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 支持 Agent 在多个独立的日常短会话中，隐式提取用户的个人偏好、生活习惯与健康约束（如座位习惯、饮食偏好、过敏源及工作日程规则）。
    - 具备时效性更新与信息覆盖（Overwriting）能力，能够自动识别偏好或规则的变更（如从肉类偏好更新为素食，或日程规则调整）。
    - 在复杂的多约束综合任务中，实现跨领域记忆的精确检索与多源信息综合应用。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **场景搭建：** 模拟 3~4 次跨越不同时间的自然短对话（订机票、餐厅菜单咨询、日程调整）。
    - **大考验证：** 发起一次“下周五出差规划”的综合指令，展示 Agent 如何自动避开花生过敏原推荐纯素食餐厅、优先勾选过道座位，并自动适配周五特有的团队例会时间表。
---

### 📅 10.26 ~ 11.01

- [ ] **Bot 会话与多应用信息汇聚打通整合**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **文字呼出与交互：** 支持在 Bot 主对话中通过自然语言/文字指令主动呼出并触发多应用信息整合特性。
    - **多源记忆接入：** 支持将多应用（Mail, Calendar, Chat 工具等）汇聚整合的信息与记忆实时接入 Bot 上下文中。
    - **主动推送与聚合：** Bot 具备主动推送能力，能将跨应用聚合后的关键动态、日程提醒与待办摘要主动推送给用户。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **主动推送与指令呼出 Demo：** 演示用户在 Bot 主界面通过文本指令（如“汇总一下各渠道最新消息”）唤醒多端整合，且 Bot 主动向用户推送包含邮件、日程与消息提醒的跨应用简报。

- [ ] **Single Agent + Single App: To-Do Creation & Follow-up**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 读取邮件内容并精准理解上下文，自动生成结构化的待办事项（To-Do Items）。
    - 依据正文中提到的时间节点自动设定明确的截止提醒（Reminders）。
    - 在后续的任务规划和日程询问中，主动进行进度跟进与状态更新。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **自动提炼待办：** 演示 Agent 从合作方发来的紧急技术评估邮件中提取任务，自动创建包含明确 Deadline（如周三中午前）的 Google Task。
    - **动态跟进与汇总：** 演示当用户询问本周未完成事项时，Agent 自动汇总并提醒即将到期的待办任务。

- [ ] **Single Agent + Single App: Email Operations & Priority Management**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 协助用户高效管理收件箱（Inbox），自动识别垃圾推广和低价值营销邮件并执行删除或归档操作。
    - 基于发件人身份、邮件主题紧急度及正文语义，自动识别高优先级邮件并进行标记或置顶。
    - 结合上下文信息，自动起草符合职场规范和语气要求的邮件回复草稿（Draft Responses）。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **收件箱自动化清理：** 演示 Agent 识别并一键清理/归档营销推广邮件，保持收件箱整洁。
    - **高优先级起草：** 演示 Agent 识别来自同事的技术求助邮件，并根据高阶指令自动生成拟定好的回复草稿。

- [ ] **Single Agent + Multi-App (Mail ⇆ Slack / Feishu Integration)**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **Cross-APP Collaboration:** 搭建跨应用自动化工作流。从 Mail 中提取待办任务后，自动通过 Slack / 飞书 向相关团队成员发送通知与任务提醒。
    - **闭环跟踪：** 当上游依赖任务或下游协助事项完成时，实时向用户发送提醒，并自动准备邮件回复草稿以闭环整个工作流。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **端到端闭环 Demo：** 演示从收到邮件需求出发 $\rightarrow$ 自动创建 Task $\rightarrow$ 触发飞书/Slack 消息通知协同方 $\rightarrow$ 收到下游完成反馈后 $\rightarrow$ 自动生成 Gmail 回复草稿的全流程。

---

### 📅 11.02 ~ 11.08｜P0：核心助手与真实应用接入

- [ ] **DigitalMate Bot 性能优化专项**
  - **特性描述：**
    - 聚焦 JiuwenSwarm 支撑 DigitalMate Bot 模式的执行链路，分析上下文准备、平台编排、模型调用、工具调用和流式返回的耗时，定位并优化瓶颈。
    - 重点记录用户发送到首个有效回复内容可见的时延、模型调用 TTFT、端到端响应时延和工具调用耗时，明确测量起止点。
    - 建立固定用例基线，在相同条件下对比优化前后结果，关注 P50/P95、超时与失败情况。
    - **成本仅记录：** 模型调用次数、输入输出 Token 和估算费用，不设成本优化目标。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - **基础对话与连续追问：** “帮我安排明天晚餐，一人份，不吃辣，30 分钟内做好” → “改成两人份” → “最好只用一口锅”，记录首次请求与多轮追问的性能。
    - **优化前后对比：** 使用相同模型、输入和运行条件重复执行固定用例，展示各阶段耗时变化；工具链路使用已有工具用例验证。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 能定位主要耗时环节，用可复现数据说明优化效果；回答完整性和上下文连续性不因优化而下降。

- [ ] **客户端应用连接与飞书、邮件场景验证**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **飞书连接验通：** 完成手机授权、连接状态展示、重新授权、断开连接，以及读取消息到总结追问的端到端验证。
    - **Composio 接入设计：** 明确手机端、DigitalMate 后端与 Composio 在授权、连接管理和应用工具调用中的职责。
    - **邮件连接验证：** 优先考虑基于 Composio 接入邮箱，验证授权、读取、总结与连续追问；首期邮箱类型需明确。
    - **只读范围：** 飞书限定单群和指定时间范围；邮件限定时间范围或线程。支持原文出处，行动项仅提取展示。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - **连接闭环：** 手机授权 → 显示连接状态 → 读取信息 → 总结与追问；验证重新授权及断开后停止新的读取。
    - **飞书项目进展：** 群内讨论“登录已完成、飞书授权等待审批、王磊预计周五反馈” → 总结进展 → 追问“谁在跟进，能确认周五完成接入吗？”区分反馈时间与完成承诺。
    - **飞书决策追踪：** “周五上线 → 建议延期 → 确定下周二上线，但须周一完成审批” → 追问最终时间、原因和未满足的前提。
    - **飞书行动项核对：** “整理本周明确交给我的事项、截止时间及后续反馈” → “哪些有完成反馈，哪些改过截止时间？”
    - **邮件重要事项：** 准备报价确认、同事知会和营销邮件 → “整理本周需要我处理的邮件” → 追问截止时间与具体要求。
    - **邮件往来追踪：** 需求由“10 份 Excel”变为“20 份并希望提供 PDF”，己方仅确认 Excel → 追问最新交付内容与未决事项。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 将模拟业务素材放入真实测试账号，通过真实连接读取；结论可追溯，追问保留上下文。区分无数据、读取失败和部分结果，不将缺少反馈推断为未完成。

- [ ] **对话归属清晰、上下文连续**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **上下文继承：** 保留任务目标、人物、时间和约束；修改某个条件时保留其他有效条件。
    - **回复绑定提问：** 回复、结果卡片和进度归属正确请求，支持定位对应提问。
    - **连续发送：** 区分原请求的补充与独立新请求，避免输入丢失、结果覆盖和上下文串线。
    - **话题切换与恢复：** 支持在主对话中切换并恢复此前讨论；指代存在歧义时简短澄清。
    - **话题导航：** 切分与归属可靠后恢复导航，支持查看相关问答并继续追问。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - **晚餐安排：** “一人份、不吃辣、30 分钟内做好” → “改成两人份” → “最好只用一口锅”。验证条件继承。
    - **出行清单：** “两天一晚、高铁出行、按可能下雨准备” → 回复完成前补充“只带双肩包、不带电脑、控制在 10 项以内”。验证补充条件作用于原任务。
    - **学习与家务：** 连续发送“七天英语口语计划，每天 15 分钟”和“另外，列一份半小时完成的书桌整理清单”。验证请求和回复分别对应。
    - **话题恢复：** 讨论“周六 14—18 点的打扫、阅读和晚饭安排” → 切换到生日祝福 → “回到周六安排，把阅读增加到一小时”。
    - **指代澄清：** 先生成生日祝福，再生成聚餐邀请 → “把前面那段改短一点”。验证确认修改对象后再调整。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 用例仅依赖当前主对话中的文本输入，可独立验收；补充较长对话、多次切换，以及失败、取消和重试场景，检查归属与上下文是否稳定。

---

### 📅 11.09 ~ 11.15｜P1：发现页：工作信息汇总与资讯简报

- [ ] **工作今日卡／跨应用汇总**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **发现页工作今日卡：** 聚合日程、待办、飞书信息，邮件作为补充，按“今日安排、待处理事项、重要动态”呈现。
    - **文字呼出与追问：** 支持在主对话中通过文字呼出，并按时间、事项或人物继续追问。
    - **关联与溯源：** 关联同一事项涉及的会议、待办、消息和邮件，保留原文出处及时间；读取失败或信息不完整时明确说明。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - 日程中有下午项目评审，飞书要求准备预算草案，待办中有报告提交任务，邮件提供参考材料。
    - 在发现页查看工作今日卡 → 主对话输入“今天有哪些事情需要处理？” → 追问“评审前需要准备什么？” → “只看下午的安排”。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 汇总范围准确，关联有依据，重复事项不过度展示；卡片与文字呼出的信息一致，追问保留上下文。

- [ ] **今日资讯简报**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **筛选与去重：** 基于已有资讯来源筛选重点内容，合并同一主题的重复报道。
    - **发现页简报卡：** 展示标题、简要摘要、来源及发布时间，支持展开详情和文字呼出。
    - **偏好反馈：** 支持“多看这类／少看这类”，影响后续简报的选题与排序。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - 准备多个来源对同一事件的报道，以及不同主题资讯 → 生成今日简报 → 在发现页查看简报卡 → 展开某条查看摘要与来源。
    - 反馈“少看消费电子，多看人工智能” → 再次生成简报，检查选题与排序变化。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 重复报道不过度占位，摘要忠于来源，偏好反馈可验证；工作信息与外部资讯分别呈现。

**第二周依赖与边界：** 复用 P0 的飞书、邮件连接能力，明确并接通日程、待办的只读数据来源。待办创建与更新、主动提醒按此前安排放到后续一周。

---

### 📅 11.16 ~ 11.22｜P1：待办管理与主动助理

- [ ] **待办提炼、截止时间与进度跟进**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **待办提炼：** 从已连接来源提取事项、负责人和截止时间，区分建议、明确安排与已确认承诺；信息不明确时进行澄清。
    - **待办管理：** 支持创建、更新、查询和标记完成，保留与原始信息的关联，避免重复创建。
    - **进度与到期跟进：** 支持查询未完成、即将到期的事项，通过统一提醒机制发送到期提醒。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - 从飞书消息“请周五 17 点前提交预算表”提取并创建待办 → 将截止时间改为下周一中午 → 查询“我还有哪些待办？” → 临近截止时间收到提醒 → 标记完成。
    - 再次读取同一条来源消息，检查是否重复创建待办。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 创建与更新结果真实可查询；截止时间修改后旧提醒失效，完成后停止提醒；缺少完成反馈不直接判定任务未完成。

- [ ] **主动提醒与适时开口**
  - **特性描述：**
    - **遗漏与上下文提醒：** 根据待办、日程及用户在对话中表达的明确计划，提醒可能遗漏的准备事项或后续行动。
    - **提醒控制：** 支持关闭提醒、配置频率、稍后提醒和免打扰；同一事项避免重复打扰。
    - **状态联动：** 事项完成、时间变化或触发条件失效后，及时取消或更新提醒。
  - **Demo 演示：**
    - **遗漏提醒：** 会议即将开始，相关材料准备待办仍未完成 → 提醒用户准备 → 标记完成后停止后续提醒。
    - **上下文提醒：** 用户说“明早出发，行李还没整理” → 在合适时间提示准备行李 → 选择稍后提醒 → 按新时间提醒。
    - **配置验证：** 分别开启免打扰、关闭该类提醒，检查触发与送达行为。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 提醒有明确依据，时机合理，频率与免打扰配置生效；能够说明提醒原因，避免重复或过期提醒。

**组件分工：** 待办模块维护事项、截止时间与完成状态；主动提醒模块统一处理触发、去重、频率和免打扰。

**统一验收要求：** 每项配套端到端用例、效果验收和性能记录；完成后补充 PR、测试结果及 Demo 证据，再更新完成状态。

---

### 📌 后续候选（可后置）


- [ ] **独立插件：Agent DM 加好友（撞上即可开聊）**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **独立插件边界：** 相对九问核心、Orbit 主线与名片/身份柜（#190）单独交付；装上即可用，不绑定 Orbit 宿主。
    - **DM 撞上加好友：** 用户在 DM 场景直接加对方 handle / agent，发出请求；对方同意后建立私聊，无需 invite link / grant 流程作为唯一入口。
    - **私聊开聊：** 加好友成功后可双向私信；默认不开放发现广场、不支持随便加陌生 agent 的公开社交图。
    - **与身份柜协作：** 发送时可选名片/身份（#190）；本项只管「跟谁建立 DM」，不管密钥保管。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **撞上加好友：** 在九问 DM 输入对方 handle → 发送好友请求 → 对方同意 → 进入私聊并发一条消息。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 好友关系可复用；拒绝/未同意时不能开聊；不出现公开广场或跨 harness 随意加好友；与 #190 选身份发送可同屏演示但不混为同一需求。


---

## 📌 更新规范 (Update Protocol)

1. 每周任务或 Demo 完成后，将对应的 `- [ ]` 更新为 `- [x]`。
2. 可在具体项下补充对应的 PR 链接、测试用例脚本或 Demo 演示链接。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A08 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A08`.

**Outcome:** Resolve Stop from the submission captured at tap time; separate durable answer receipt from live continuation.

**Owner:** Agent Service interaction owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Resolve Stop from the submission captured at tap time; separate durable answer receipt from live continuation, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py::SQLiteSessionRepository.cancel_turn; respond_to_interaction` into `server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py; server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py; server/agent_service/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py; server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py; server/agent_service/proxy.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py) — `SQLiteSessionRepository.cancel_turn; respond_to_interaction`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/execution.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/execution.py) — `stop, answer`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py) — `interaction records`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/harness-run-control.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/harness-run-control.md) — `Durable question and answer receipt`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- A continues, B retained, C proceeds
- Question-keyed answers and card IDs
- Committed success wins when already authoritative

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Rerouting Stop by proximity
- Stopping all active tasks
- Ordinary questions treated as approval

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/session_store/interactions.py
- server/agent_service/backend/interactions.py
- server/agent_service/proxy.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a08.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-M16](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/786), [DM31-M17](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/787), [DM31-A17](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/792)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-A10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/760), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Supplement needs A20; question receipt is not supplement consumption

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Delayed route/receipt Stop affects only B while A/C continue
- Duplicate answer resumes once; wrong Q/R rejects
- Reopened receipt without live owner does not fabricate continuation

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a08

**Cases:** - A/B/C public barriers
- One-to-four answers and lost acknowledgement
- Failed Stop write retains revocation fence

**Participants:** Real backend controls/Manager/Store with file-backed SQLite; scripted live wait and controlled provider; barriers around delayed admission, receipt, Stop and final commit.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, controls. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0005, host-operation-lifecycle.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Background and Goal Description

<!-- DM31:MASTER -->

<!-- DM31:IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF -->

**Implementation entry point:** [Read the English implementation handoff](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/implementation-handoff.md). The assigned implementation agent should follow its autonomous contract-first workflow: verify and merge contracts and gates, prove compliance through a real consumer PR, then expand dependent development. Isolate genuine blockers in issues and continue eligible work without requesting routine maintainer decisions. This is the subsequent implementation phase; the original survey remains planning evidence, not an implementation pass.

<!-- /DM31:IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF -->

Deliver the **production v3.1 server refactor from main**, preserving main's supported product behavior while making the accepted component contracts, state ownership and default deployment real. This is the formal implementation task graph, not a claim that migration code, tests, deployment or feature parity already exists.

**Frozen survey:** main `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`; architecture reference `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`, sampled from remote HEAD at the start on 2026-11-07. Main advanced from supplied `077c4eab` only through the UserManagementPage back-button/layout change; that client change is included. The architecture checkout's local `aab978c4` was not substituted for the frozen reference. Subsequent implementation starts from current main and reconciles its delta without rewriting the survey.

**Authority:** frozen ADR-0001–0010, [boundaries](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/boundaries.md), [Host lifecycle](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md), [general capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md), [run controls](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/harness-run-control.md) and v3.1 diagram sources. Authority classes: **A** accepted behavior/boundaries; **B** actual frozen-main enabled or supported configured behavior; **C** candidate implementation/verification with exact scope; **D** accepted but not delivered; **E** proposed strategy. Candidate code and old test counts do not promote C/E into A or completed main work. Orbit materials are external evidence; DM ADRs authorize the general capabilities.

**Non-goals:** no architecture-foundation merge, validation-tree wholesale copy, opaque old daemon behind a proxy, unrelated phone rewrite, new ADX/login/sandbox platform, externally independent execution authority, automatic product implementation/deployment, development-trigger labels, repository freeze or permanent legacy allowlist. Cleanup is bonus-only with reachability/configuration/equivalent-replacement evidence.

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

**Research and coverage entry points (English):**

- [Frozen baseline, all-issue/PR search disposition and dedup](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/baseline-and-dedup.md)
- [Actual main entries, configuration, deep I/O and tests](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md)
- [Complete product-action coverage and dispositions](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/action-coverage.md)
- [Source/capability → migration issue → acceptance matrix](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/coverage-matrix.md)
- [Accepted versus candidate evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md)
- [Architecture rule → authority → legal/illegal fixture → CI → owner matrix and production acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md)
- [Decision register](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/decisions.md), [developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md), [independent planning review](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/review.md)

**Existing work reused, not duplicated or silently changed:** #571 E1–E3 assertions, #565 E4–E6 corpus/evidence and #500 cleanup remain open shared work; consume their actual delivered portions and preserve pending status. #698/PR #699 workspace-binding defect/fix is an integration input, not asserted merged. #311 existing isolation report remains separate. #505/PR #509 is an older modularization plan, not this accepted authority/deletion/base policy. #324/PR #323 is provenance history; PR #588 is optional-dependency work to reconcile. #570 failure-protocol and #271 Orbit integration remain their own proposals; no phone rewrite or Orbit product scope is imported. New issues below cover the main migration, not those existing projects.

**Batch and concurrency rules:** phases are integration milestones, not all-to-all barriers. P0 delivers inventory/public contracts, real legal/illegal scanner fixtures, trusted early CI, CODEOWNERS/enforcement plan and old-branch development guidance. P1 forms the genuine unchanged-client CHAT-01/02 vertical. P2 extracts capability modules; P3 closes policy/accounting/control/recovery; these overlap when named hard prerequisites permit. P4 is independent integrated acceptance.

Parallel sets after contracts: model transport / plugin dispatch / identity / ownership scanner; then skill mapping / source search / artifacts / media fixtures / conditional providers; then independent QA preparation and separate A/B case groups under an exclusive device lease. The graph and each issue's writable files govern actual scheduling; examples do not permit shared-file edits.

**Single-owner serial lanes:** A01 public identity/error types; A14 shared hook/attempt/reservation types; Store owner serializes A02→A03, then the ready A08/A12/A15/A29/A30/A17/M18 persistence changes in dependency order with one schema merge at a time; Host lifecycle owner serializes A06/A07/A08 and subsequent A26/A23 enforcement changes. The arrow here expresses ownership sequencing, not permission to skip prerequisites. Other module extraction and tests proceed independently. G01 records named maintainers; role labels below do not invent GitHub assignees.

**Critical paths:** identity/contracts → Store admission/context → Manager/Registry/Host/backend → Runtime/Router + normal factory/model/tool adapters → G07/Q03 → unchanged CHAT-01/02. Checkpoint and same-S decisions run early and gate only their dependent adapter/persistence/control activation. Full acceptance additionally requires child/deep I/O, supported conditional business paths, production accounting/inspect, format/old-writer guard, A/B corpus and independent verdict. A compatible format guard blocks new-format traffic, not unrelated extraction work.

**Per-task migration completion requires:** default production calls transferred to the named owner; old entry deleted or public-proxy-only delegate; no duplicate authority/dual write/silent fallback; bypass/reconnection mutants fail gates; developer extension interface, owner and exact test command documented. A contract, investigation or QA issue instead delivers its explicitly stated artifact and never claims a production switch.

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象：** 在对话里**直接粘贴图片**（不是发附件链接、也不是给文件路径）后，助手气泡只回一句英文 `The source is private to a different audience`，图片没有被解析成任何可读内容，也无法基于图片内容作答。

**复现步骤：**
1. 打开 DigitalMate 对话（web 渠道）。
2. 直接在输入框粘贴一张图片（例如 image_1794018912951.png），不附带文件路径。
3. 发送后观察助手回复。

**预期：** 同一会话内粘贴的图片应可被读取并用于回答；若暂不支持识图，应给出**中文、可理解**的能力提示（如「当前对话暂不支持直接识图，请改用文件方式」），而不是抛出内部 `PermissionError` 原文。

**实际：** 图片内容完全不可读，只回显 `The source is private to a different audience`。该报错容易被误解为用户贴错/图损坏，实际是本端把贴进来的图当作「当前会话无权访问的私有来源」挡在门外。

```text
The source is private to a different audience
```

**判断（可能根因，与历史单一致）：** 与 #453 同源——上传/落地成 Source 时 `allowed_actor_ids` 只写 `[principal_id]`，而 `source_visible_in_room` 要求 `people_in_room ⊆ allowed_actor_ids`；房间里有其他成员时校验失败，组 brief 时抛出该 `PermissionError` 并原文进气泡。修复 PR #462（把 room uploads 的 audience 设为 `room.member_ids`）目前仍为 open，未见合入/上线，故线上仍复现。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 产品：DigitalMate 对话应用（digitalmate）
- 渠道：web
- 时间：2026-11-07 10:30–10:42（Asia/Shanghai），多轮贴图均可复现
- 输入方式：直接在对话中粘贴图片（非文件路径）
- 涉及图片示例：image_1794018912951.png
- 浏览器/系统：未单独记录，可后续补充

### Additional Information

- 关联历史单：#453（[Bug]: v0.1.6 发附件报 The source is private to a different audience）、修复 #462（fix(server): give room uploads the room audience (#453)，当前仍 open）。本单强调「直接粘贴图片」这条路径，且报错文案对用户有误导性。
- 建议：（1）附件/贴图路径保证同房间可读（合入 #462 思路）；（2）客户端把该错误映射为中文可理解提示，禁止内部 `PermissionError` 原文进气泡（关联 #359）；（3）短期若无法识图，贴图时直接给可操作引导。

### Version Information

- 仓库 main 分支对应版本；线上为当前部署构建（具体版本号待补）。历史同错见 v0.1.6（#453）。

### Screenshots / Recordings

- 该问题正是「贴图本身无法被读入」，故本端拿不到图片字节、无法自动附上截图；报错原文已在上方代码块给出。如需要可视证据，可请复现同学在客户端截图补充。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:Q02 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-Q02`.

**Outcome:** Same HAP/driver/assertions/cases/model conditions compare main and candidate; all 36 current cases have explicit disposition.

**Owner:** Independent QA coordinator. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No duplicate #571 or #565 driver/assertion work
- Do not use historical 23 cases as current full set
- Manifest/fixture preparation needs no device lease; installation/execution requires Q01. Strict historical 7c official build and alternate compilation are separate evidence classes, not interchangeable A/B identities.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json::version registry` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tests/e2e/workflow/migration/main-baseline-manifest.json; tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/case-versions.json) — `version registry`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/case-identity.mjs](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/case-identity.mjs) — `case identity module`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md) — `Version and build receipts`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing case IDs, versions, tier/lane/stability semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Changing assertions or client messages only for candidate

**Writable boundary:**
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/main-baseline-manifest.json
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/run-ab.mjs
- tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.test.mjs

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** None; may start from the frozen evidence.

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/772)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738), [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- HAP SHA and install receipts match on both sides
- Freeze driver, cases, catalog, calibration, model and config identities
- Include disabled-by-default cases explicitly
- Existing todo controller capability remains BLOCKED on original issue
- Main advances trigger updated A and affected paired reruns
- run-ab invokes the existing run-workflow per explicit case; compare A/B manifests and reject changed HAP/driver/assertion hashes. Fixture tests prove only backend identity may differ. No mutation to case assertions or phone protocol.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Checks:** - Existing case/catalog/provenance validators
- Compare A/B manifest allowing only endpoint/profile/deployment identities to differ

**Participants:** Independent QA, same frozen HAP and original driver/assertions; actual old/new backend builds. Controlled input/fault fixture is named per case; it cannot replace actual phone or new production owner. Exclusive resource lease needed for execution.

**Evidence:** A/B backend identity and M/S/R/Host/Store trace; PASS/FAIL/environment-BLOCKED/NOT-RUN separately; retain baseline failures.

**Commands:** - node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --list
- node tests/e2e/workflow/run-workflow.mjs --validate
- node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
