items.body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Reduce delayed reply delivery and silent waiting while preserving streamed formal answers.

- Remove ReplyStream's fixed one-second wait. Isolate per-connection push outboxes, coalesce disposable progress and prioritize reliable FIFO body/approval/commit/final events. Bound queued traffic and close stalled consumers for snapshot recovery.
- Backport only Huben's WorkSwarm develop fix 8a4073832c9d47efedeedde0f7d4e778f2c2a5f2 (!8230), streaming resumed question/confirmation execution while retaining heartbeat policy and exclusive control claims. Keep the vendored base pinned; record both overrides and derived provenance.
- Append missing completion tails/source footers instead of replaying an unchanged whole answer. Necessary actual final corrections remain supported. Completion removes stale queued progress and triggers urgent phone synchronization.
- Keep real thinking/search/tool/reading/editing/checking/writing/waiting/recovery phases in the pet bar. End its working state immediately on the final marker, before snapshot catch-up. Sanitize activity paths, secrets and raw command/tool details.
- Show optional public key updates in one temporary assistant bubble, with the formal reply style and no copy/reference toolbar. Useful findings, important next steps, verified waiting reasons and concise user-facing rationale based on observed facts may appear; hidden step-by-step reasoning and raw tool output must not. Remove the former blanket ban on execution preambles. Do not require an update for each tool or synthesize canned prose when none was supplied.
- Keep the latest public bubble alongside streamed formal text; a subsequent update replaces its text. End it on task completion/final marker. Formal body is independent and is never replaced by progress. Direct answers without any intermediate bubble are valid.
- Phone: first character immediately, then adaptive 24ms reveal up to 32 UTF-16 units with emoji boundary protection. Handle final-snapshot-before-delta and durable handoff without replaying history.
- Clean empty source bullets and use readable hostname source labels. Subagent streaming remains outside scope.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #373 per product decision. Full execution-history UI and stalled-task detection remain outside scope.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

Final head: 176dded1d36224365572eed9431bff0b39bc9ec4. Exactly ONE commit above main e48edbf8fd18987efd72c70752ed14aec9855cf2. Squashed at the user's request; original author identity is preserved. The previous PR history is retained locally for audit.

- Standard full Node suite: 2757 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped (2764 total).
- Cloud ReplyStream/fake-Gateway/search/push/source suite on the final head: 71 passed and 14 subtests passed. Activity/progress service checks: 3 passed, 49 deselected.
- Actual vendored runtime control-stream regression: 3 passed. Source provenance verification and git diff --check passed.
- HAP assembleHap: SUCCESSFUL in 3m02.034s, 70 tasks executed, unsigned. Built client sources are identical to the final commit; the last amend only changed the cloud prompt and a stale test assertion.
- New end-to-end test sends an optional marked key update through fake WorkSwarm Gateway -> actual bridge -> phone WebSocket while a tool is still blocked. The captured WebSocket event is then consumed by the actual ArkTS conversation projection and replyProgressText method in Node. Verifies visible public bubble, latest-only replacement alongside body and immediate removal on final marker.
- A separate no-commentary tool case verifies no public sentence is invented. Existing tests verify native commentary, private reasoning exclusion, absolute-path filtering, no progress/raw tool output in formal or stored answers, FIFO body/final delivery, slow-consumer isolation and completion/snapshot races.
- Red/green verification covered the earlier absent public-progress path; after scope clarification, mandatory/canned tool prose was removed rather than shipped. Final tests cover both optional updates and silence.
- Full Python engine suite was not run on this head. Earlier broader tests had four failures reproduced on unmodified baseline 6d86d5a2; that baseline comparison is historical evidence, not a current full-suite pass.
- No final-head CI/ST pass, real-model A/B timing, final-head device installation or after-change device screenshots/recordings is claimed. Those remain outstanding. Functional tests do not establish quantified end-to-end speedup.

Deployment: update BOTH cloud image (optional public-update prompt and streaming delivery) and phone HAP (retain latest process bubble alongside formal body and finish promptly). No data migration or new configuration is needed. Neither the currently installed phone package nor an earlier image automatically receives this change.

Limitations: public updates are optional model output, so an empty bubble is valid. Final-only upstream responses and reconnect snapshots cannot provide real token streaming. Ordinary unmarked prose is preserved to avoid losing answers. Existing optional stream fields remain compatible; activity adds optional progress_text and preparing kind. Interface approval is not claimed.

**Self-checklist**:（**Please check carefully,and mark an x in the [] brackets. We will review your completion status.**）

+ - [ ] **Design**: Has the solution corresponding to the PR been reviewed by the Maintainer, and have all review comments been replied to and revised
+ - [ ] **Test**: Has the code in the PR been fully covered by UT/ST test cases, and have the newly added test cases been uploaded to the repository along with this PR or already uploaded.
+ - [x] **Verification**: Does the PR description contains a detailed description of the verification results regarding the achievement of the expected goals for the Feature, Refactor, and Bugfix to this PR.
+ - [ ] **Interface**: Does it involve changes to external interfaces? The corresponding changes have been approved by the interface review organization, and the annotation information for the API has been correctly refreshed.
+ - [ ] **Document**: Does it involve modifications to the official website documentation? If so, please submit the materials to the Doc repository in a timely manner.

Architecture experiment ARC-CONTEXT-BIND-01 separates durable same-session input receipts from execution-context binding for fresh text-only turns. A held A can complete while pre-stopped B is retained once and C is durably admitted without entering a provider. After quiescent reopen, an explicit retry executes the same C once using A's committed prefix.

Head `b3d555c3`; base `codex/architecture-foundation`. Dependency: #712 exact `56fb241a` (includes #708 `19870cae`). The change relative to that dependency is **only four new files in experiments/context_bind/**; no production source, normal/cloud/mobile composition, accepted spec or main branch is modified. Draft architecture evidence only: do not merge to main or activate this DB dialect in production.

The opt-in candidate subclasses the real SQLite Store and Manager. It introduces explicit version1 pending/bound context state and NULL pending snapshots without repurposing attachment input_ready. Immutable submissions.payload remains the sole input authority. Receipt/claim/read overrides are experimental; current Registry/ProfileLoader, Manager identity/fingerprint/control policy, Router ingress, Runtime/AS, C2 sealing, Host context/model gates and atomic final/CAS are real reused components. The model/Harness and next-C retry driver are controlled fixtures, not another execution authority or scheduler.

Validation: native Python 3.11.2 with fixed-source Core, **45 tests passed, zero failures/errors/skips**: six new experiment ST plus existing Runtime/different-S cancellation, F2/F3 and selection regressions. Two independent SQLite connections contend at a barrier with exactly one claimed and one queued; stale final CAS is rejected. Tests cover same M duplicate/conflict, owner scope, B pre-Stop and queued Stop, zero B/C entry while A runs, pending snapshot failure, close/reopen, same C/S/R/configuration, prefix/final revisions1→2→3→4, Stop(B) while C is active, and final committed/lost ACK idempotency. The baseline against the current Store retained a real red: B changed A's revision1→2. Evidence: control/arc-context-bind-baseline-red.log and control/arc-context-bind-native.log. Independent review and delivery Python3.13 remain pending.

Explicit fixture policy: never-applied cancelled B stays in product receipt history and is not automatically applied to later execution context. This is not accepted main product policy. Closes #698

## What

A task's selected project directory was stored but dropped before the Bridge opened its WorkSwarm session. File operations could consequently use a generated task folder instead of the selected directory.

Forward `Task.project_path`, select or create the native WorkSwarm project, and pass its binding during session creation. Include the normalized directory in scope ownership so a continuation cannot reuse a session from another project. Preserve projectless identities and `work` mode; refuse incompatible existing bindings.

## Validation

- Reproduced the forwarding failure against unmodified main `fc08933b4a3fa1ac5e95f9843afe7a756ddda42d`, without a model call.
- 105 WorkSwarm tests passed, including forwarding, same/different-project reuse, restart, rotation, missing-directory rejection, binding drift and lost-create-response recovery.
- 37 existing conversation and task-clear tests passed.
- Contributor guide Node command: 2,658 passed, two skipped, no failures, with CI-pinned test dependencies.
- Docker native API check passed: explicit directory binding, unchanged `work` mode, same-project session reuse and different-project isolation. The v0.1.8 runtime used the changed product service source read-only, with networking disabled and no model calls.
- `git diff --check` passed.

[Reproduction, commands, limits and visual evidence](docs/developer_guide/evidence/project-workspace-binding/README.md).

## Risk and limits

Explicit project requests now register/select a WorkSwarm project and require an existing absolute directory. An existing project in another mode is rejected rather than modified. The directory becomes part of session identity; switching projects starts a distinct session. Projectless sessions retain their existing identities.

No prompts, model settings, tools, vendored execution sources or execution modes were changed. Live model-driven file editing and HarmonyOS device behavior were not tested. This PR does not claim improved answer accuracy.



## Main branch integration

Conflict resolved in `5753a89b61f47187fe7a0f6c069d7f49acef6cf5` by merging main `3088fdf9f8b0ae16eacecdaf842addd7d6e893bc`. Both project binding and upstream runtime-generation tracking are retained. The new regression verifies project-preserving reconnect and durable runtime-generation acquisition.

Post-merge validation: 65 adapter/project/unload tests and 49 project/conversation tests passed (the groups overlap). A broader discovery had 116 passes and one launcher-policy error because the local environment lacks the newly required installed WorkSwarm runtime overlay. This prerequisite was not bypassed. CI is rerunning on the new head.

Prepare a deterministic, immutable operation descriptor from the actual nested function-call shape, the full owner/submission/session/run scope, and an exact tool reference. Canonical argument and identity bytes remain unchanged when the caller mutates its original mapping; changed recipients, scope fields, call IDs or tool versions change the identity. This is the pure identity contract for ADR-0008 only. It adds two files and does not change HostAPI dispatch, policy, Store, approvals or phone behavior. A hash is correlation data, not authority; filenames/URLs are not verified immutable content references. Actual C3 enforcement and durable Ask coordination await the published C2 selection/dispatch-ordering contract (#708) and the existing Store owner. Fixes #581 — same-conversation count pacts (“问满十遍…”) and their fulfillment/count were recomputed from a short history window, so after a few quiet minutes the assistant treated an already-fulfilled pact as pending and restarted the count at 1.

Add an explicitly enabled AccountAuthority for a gateway-authenticated, single-user instance and its dedicated workspace. It returns the legacy instance-local `p_local` identity and applies the legacy browser-origin rule without deriving identity from request headers or binding IDs.

读屏在每个返回按钮后面多停一个「图片」节点，同一个控件被念两遍；心上事列表里每条记录后面也一样多一个停靠点。父节点已经有可读名，缺的是把纯装饰的箭头图标移出无障碍树：

Fixes #449

## 问题

英文设备的用户走的是同一条云端连接状态链路，但连接横幅的文本与动作按钮都是硬编码中文：读屏聚焦横幅时整块播报未翻译的中文状态（例如「正在连接云端…」），英文用户看到的按钮是「重新加载」「正在连接」「立即重试」，既读不懂当前状态，也不知道按下去会重连。连接链路其余文案都经 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` / `digitalmateBusinessError()` 收敛成可读句子，唯独这一处把中文字面量直接渲染进 `Text` 与 `Button`，没有任何语言分支。

## 修法

- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`：`digitalmateConnectBanner()` 与 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 增加可选 `language` 参数（默认 `'zh-CN'`），`en` 开头（`/^en\b/i`）输出英文，其它语言逐字节维持现状；新增 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel(kind, language)` 统一产出三个按钮文案（`reload` / `connecting` / `retry`）。`digitalmateBusinessError()` 的透传分支保持原样——服务端业务原文不翻译。
- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`：组件字段初始化器里取一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（不进 `aboutToAppear`，既有 banner fixture 不受影响）（仓库现有唯一语言入口，与 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 同源），把该语言传给横幅文案、`accessibilityText` 与三个按钮文案；显隐条件、重试逻辑、样式与 5 秒 slow 定时器不变。
## 未纳入本 PR

- 客户端自有文案经调用方传入、仍未英文化的一批：`'正在同步云端会话…'`（会话加载中）与网关恢复态的两句 `'正在恢复云端连接…'` / `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试连接'`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `beginGatewayRecover()` 与横幅入参）。这句是客户端自有文案，但走的是 `digitalmateBusinessError()` 的业务消息透传分支，因此本 PR 的 `language` 参数管不到它——英文设备在这一态仍会看到中文状态，按钮已是英文 `Reload`。
- 本轮不改的原因：该文件同时被多项未合入 PR 占用（本 PR 开题时抓取的占用快照命中 `#334`、`#391`、`#441`、`#474`、`#481`、`#555`），改它会与这些 PR 直接冲突。
- 已建独立 tracking issue 跟进：见 #564（含改法、验收标准与前置占用清单）。
- 范围确认：`#563` 的生产代码只改 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 与 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`，不碰 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`。

- **二次本地化兜底（F1）**：调用方会先把错误本地化成中文再存进 `this.error`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`），横幅再以英文渲染时原本会原样透出中文。现在 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 持有本模块**自有文案**的 zh→en 对照（10 条 + `正在重新连接云端（第 N 次）…` 正则），英文路径先查表再走正则；`state === 'open'` 的业务透传分支只在命中自有文案时才替换，**服务端 / 模型原文照旧原样透传**。英文路径同时把 `证书|certificate|SSL|TLS` 提到 `网络|…` 之前，避免 TLS 失败被报成「网络不可用」；中文路径的判定顺序一字未改。
- 共 2 个生产文件，不动 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`（被 #481 占用），不碰 `cloud-adapter/.../CloudMarkdown.ets`（#547 / #403）。

## 可达性

1. `entryability/EntryAbility.ets` 冷启动 `loadContent('pages/A2uiHome/Index')`。
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` 的 `CloudConversationBody()` 在 `cloudBackend === 'digitalmate'` 时渲染 `DigitalMateConversationBinding`；该后端是默认值（`resources/rawfile/app_config.example.json` 的 `"cloudBackend": "digitalmate"`）。
3. `DigitalMateConversationBinding` 的 `build()` 里 `if (this.state !== 'open' || this.error)` 渲染本组件，而 `state` 初值为 `'closed'`——冷启动第一帧横幅必然出现；断开、超时、重连中也走同一分支。
4. 全屏会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 也直接使用同一组件，两个入口共用这份文案。

## 测试

先红后修：`tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs` 把 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 去掉类型后在 vm 里**真执行**（不复制实现），并静态守卫组件装配。

```text
# 红基线 eb1408de（= f69d6335 + 只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs
✖ every Chinese sentence the module emits is translated when it is fed back in English
✖ a caller that localises the error first still gets English from the banner, and server text is untouched
✖ the four stored Chinese errors still read in English when a caller pre-localised them
ℹ tests 10 · pass 7 · fail 3
```

```text
# 最终 head 5de0ad69
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-ux.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-banner.test.mjs
ℹ tests 21 · pass 21 · fail 0 · skipped 0
```

基线不动：`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs` → `Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.`

残留（未验证，不当成已验证）：英文串若再被喂回 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 会被二次分类——`'Reconnecting to the cloud (attempt 2)…'` 含 `econn`（Reconnecting 的子串）、`'Secure connection failed…'` 含 `network`，都会被判成网络失败。当前路径不可达（banner 的 `connecting` 分支直接返回，不做二次分类），中文侧不受影响，故本 PR 不改；但不视为「已验证安全」。

未验证（不伪造）：真机 TalkBack / VoiceOver 的实际朗读与 `.accessibilityGroup(true)` 下的焦点顺序——沙箱没有 HarmonyOS 设备，只做了源码级执行断言。另有一处新增调用语境：本 PR 让组件在**字段初始化器**里调用 `digitalmateClientContext()`，即仓库里第一次在 UI 构造期调用 `i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()`（其余 6 个调用点都在提交/发送路径），其构造期异常行为未经真机验证。

## 回归护栏（变异验证）

`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 的每一处英文分支都有断言钉住，删掉即变红（每条都实跑过）：`digitalmateEnglish()` 恒 false → 3 红；只删 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel('reload'|'connecting'|'retry', language)` 的 language 实参 → 各 1 红；只删 `.accessibilityText(...)` 的 language → 1 红；字段初始化器硬编码 `'en'` 或 `'zh-CN'` → 各 1 红；英文证书优先分支 `if (english && …)` 改成 `if (false && …)` → 1 红；open 态英文改走通用映射 → 1 红。

最后一条对应断言 `a server business message in the open state stays verbatim even when it mentions a mapped keyword`：open 态的服务端业务原文即便含 `网络` / `超时` / `证书` 等被映射的关键词，英文下也必须逐字节原样透传（本 PR 只翻译模块自有的 10 条规范句与重连模板，不翻译服务端与模型输出）。

## 范围

基于 `main@f69d6335`，3 文件 `+558/−22`：生产 2 个文件 `+97/−22`（`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` `+84/−17`、`DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets` `+13/−5`），测试 1 个文件 `+461/−0`。Reviewer 最终 delta 评审：**93/100，`Scored on 5de0ad69`**。

| agent-core | docx2txt, cacheout | dropped — nothing imports them |

## Why the default path stays intact

- Reachability was checked by parsing every module-level import in both packages and doing a transitive closure from the real entry points (`jiuwenswarm.server.app_agentserver`, `jiuwenswarm.server.agent_ws_server`, `jiuwenswarm.gateway.app_gateway`). After these changes the closure contains **zero** module-level imports of any removed package.
- `transformers` is used only by local-model features (guardrail local backend, transformers-backed progressive retrieval, RL/SFT tokenizer helpers), all of which already import it lazily. The only eager import (the veRL SFT dataset tokenizer types) is now behind `TYPE_CHECKING`.
- `gateway/channel_manager/__init__.py` resolves IM channel classes through PEP 562 `__getattr__`, so a channel SDK is imported only when that channel is first used. `app_gateway` already imported each platform module lazily.
- `image_tools.py` imports `google.genai` inside `_invoke_gemini_vision`.
- `checkpointer/inmemory.py` had an unused `pymilvus` import on the startup path; it is removed. `MilvusConnector` imports `pymilvus.utility` at its three call sites.
- `dashscope_embedding.py` now imports the SDK only when it builds a request. This matters because `openjiuwen.core.retrieval.lazy_load._load_openai()` imports that module for every OpenAI/VLLM embedding lookup, so a module-level `import dashscope` would have made DashScope mandatory for OpenAI embeddings.
- `mermaid` was already behind a `try/except ModuleNotFoundError` guard; `matplotlib` is only imported inside functions.
- `agentdescent` and `gitcode-api` stay base dependencies: `openjiuwen.rsi` imports them at module level, and that package is loaded from the workswarm auto-harness path.
- `openjiuwen[all]` / `all-vector` now include the new extras so a full install still installs what used to be unconditional.
- `harness/UPSTREAM.json` records every customized file and the recomputed imported Git trees for both components.

Behaviour change to note: a deployment that enables an IM channel, the Gemini vision backend, a local model or an external vector backend must install the matching extra; nothing else changes. The DigitalMate image builds only the base wheels, so image/video generation continues to use the HTTP-based `visual_gen`/`video_gen` paths, not the DashScope SDK.

## Verification

- `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` — both components OK (manifests, overrides, recomputed imported Git trees).
- Module-level import audit from the startup entry points — 0 imports of the removed packages.
- `python -B -m unittest discover -s harness/tests` — merged with current `main`; the only errors in this sandbox are four `test_tool_index_reuse` cases importing `pydantic`, which is not installed here. Those tests are unrelated to this change.
- Docker-level wheel build was not run locally (the environment has no working build backend); CI/image build will exercise it.

Inside Store's existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE admission transaction, duplicate M is reconciled first; a new M then rechecks the owner-scoped source M/S/R, part, digest and selected text before committing its binding and sealed typed input. Quote plus attachments and competing explicit routes are rejected in this first text-only scope. The frozen phone quote selector currently has no safe published-reference read operation. This accepted first slice adds Gateway-owned read-only resolution for exact published {room_id,message_id} and legacy {task_id,part} selectors. It calls public Runtime.read_submission with the verified owner and published M, checks M/S/R, part eligibility and exact authoritative text, and returns only the selected text plus checked identities.

Unknown/restarted-away mappings fail unavailable; cross-owner/principal/room and client authority fields fail before history access. Modern/legacy selectors of the same source are aliases. EARLY remains the selected source even when the frozen caller's follows points at a later turn. No ID-prefix decoding, other component private state, lease, source-version token or quote submission is introduced. Only projection.py gains an additive public read operation; shared Gateway dispatch, navigation/protocol, Runtime/Router/Manager/Store and their types remain unchanged. The branch is rebased onto merged #640. Production quoted task.create stays UNSUPPORTED.

Validation at integrated architecture base 1ae184231f49f5791f1bc534f3f06574b78b4978 (includes #640): all 55 Gateway UT and 53 Gateway ST pass, zero skips (0.284s and 14.445s) in the pinned delivery image. This includes 11 new UT and 7 new ST covering real public Runtime/SQLite publication, same-S source/part distinction, wrong scope, missing source, facade reopen with empty projection, authorized non-home room publication from public history, substituted history identities/text/type, UTF-8 output limits, rich-reader field isolation and disabled production submission. Resolver reads add zero model/classifier work. Existing artifact WSS/Core, attachment, date, replay, disconnect and authority revocation regressions also pass with their controlled providers.

Independent review found an admitted-state gap; a real Runtime test pauses on_admitted before claim and reproduced RED, then passed after accepting admitted asks. Replies still need a completed authoritative answer and published result. The updated code was freshly rerun; peer review of the fix was requested but the team tool hit its thread limit, so no independent fixed-head approval is claimed.

Authorization is the existing trusted AccountAuthority call path, not construction of a VerifiedScope dataclass. Revocation observed before request authorization denies; later revocation can race with reads/admission; delivery reauthorization can suppress a response without undoing acceptance. The output has a64KiB UTF-8 ceiling, but the unchanged history facade reads the full record first; no bounded-allocation claim is made. Publication is transient and is not rebuilt by guessing IDs after restart. This is a component read slice, not phone quote acceptance or atomic admission. #657's proposal is separately revised to remove a mandatory lease, settle retry/alias/follows correlation, and leave atomic sealing plus both execution paths for later owner-approved work.

The current authenticated aiohttp transport rejects a legal 788,083-byte PNG at its 64 KiB complete-message limit. Raising that global limit also delivers a 900,050-byte ordinary-shaped message before an action check. This evidence-only draft records those real-WS counterexamples and an isolated, optional wsproto admission experiment. It changes tests/docs only; production startup, Gateway, rooms, transport and dependency lists are untouched.

The experiment authenticates before upgrade, applies a hard declared-frame ceiling, identifies the frozen 7c upload action within a bounded prefix, checks server owner/room authority, rejects duplicate keys/compression, and accounts for fragmentation, deadlines and concurrent retained-input reservations. The frozen client request/reply consumer reaches the actual attachment adapter, Runtime and private SQLite, preserving PNG hash through typed input sealing and HostAPI Revision 3. Model/tool calls are zero. This is a controlled component result, not a HAP/phone result or approval to replace the production stack.

Validation on architecture base `1343987e0d22e77a632e5b32e9c696bafc8fc837`: 60 tests passed, zero skips in 18.912s in the delivery Python 3.13.16 image (6 policy, 12 prototype real-WS, 3 isolated-process WSS/capacity, 9 existing-transport audit ST, 30 existing Gateway UT). Independent review reproduced retained-message/deadline counterexamples and verified their fixes; it separately reran the capacity probes and injected readiness failure to confirm process/temp cleanup. Experimental wsproto/h11 wheels are hash-pinned, MIT, installed only into an isolated temporary target. Explicit `probe_` modules keep the dependency and private QA comparison optional.

Additional measured evidence:

- Exact 5 MiB PNG through frozen consumer, verified WSS, existing QA Authority implementation, actual attachment worker/Runtime/HostAPI: Revision 3 and native SHA match; model calls 0. The generated fixture uses a valid private ancillary chunk to reach the exact image byte ceiling.
- Exact 10 MiB CSV staging preserves SQLite BLOB length/hash; 10 MiB + 1 rejects with no second source. This is upload acceptance, not CSV parsing/model acceptance.
- Emulated 64 KiB fragmentation requires 107 frames for the 5 MiB PNG envelope. The candidate's 32-frame policy closes 1009 at frame 33. This compatibility counterexample is retained, not silently tuned away; native HAP fragmentation is unknown.
- Separate server-process RSS baseline 58,316 KiB; high-water 137,884 KiB for the image workload and 149,912 KiB for CSV. This includes Runtime/SQLite/TLS/durable state and is not a concurrent/adversarial capacity guarantee.
- Existing QA Authority class is source-hash checked, with fresh random test credentials and no live state/session/token copies. Unknown CA and incorrect hostname fail certificate validation; bad bearer/binding return 401 before WS data/application/source work. That actual available QA Authority is synthetic; production AGC/account authentication is not established.

Open decisions: canonical JSON order is narrower than general JSON equivalence; public Extension header-policy usage needs upgrade/maintainability review; native fragmentation, production authority and adversarial/concurrent memory/backpressure remain unverified. No HAP/phone success, production stack replacement or deployment approval is claimed. All production code/dependency lists remain unchanged.

items.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. Fixes #379 (user-visible report of the same quiet-turn hang). See also #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

## What & why

Issue #353 asks for a WeChat-style "新消息" experience. The bot review on the
issue correctly found that the floating "↓" button already exists
(`showJumpToLatest` / `jumpToLatest`), so this PR implements only the part that
was actually missing:

- **Unread boundary.** When the reader leaves the bottom of the list, the last
  settled row is recorded. A live stream row is skipped on purpose: when it
  commits it becomes a different row id, and the finished reply must still
  count as new.
- **"新消息" divider.** The first assistant reply after that boundary carries a
  blue "新消息" divider (rendered inside its `ListItem`, so list indices used by
  `scrollToIndex` stay stable).
- **"↓ 新消息" button.** The existing floating button now shows the unread label
  and count (capped at `99+`), plus an accessibility label. With no unread
  replies it stays the plain "↓" as before.
- **Clearing.** Reaching the first unseen reply advances the boundary (the
  divider moves to the next unseen one); jumping to the latest or reaching the
  bottom clears the state. Switching room/topic or changing account resets it.

Nothing changes when the user is at the bottom: the list keeps auto-following
and no hint appears.

## Tests

New `tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs` covers the three states
from the issue (at bottom / reading history / returning to the page), the
stream-row edge case, divider advancement and jump clearing.

`gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs` loads the new helpers because it exercises
`setFollowLatest`/`render` in isolation.

```
node --test tests/unit/gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-pending-card-in-stream.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-topic-async.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-notifications.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-stream-presentation.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs
# 184 tests, 184 pass
```

The full `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` run has 5 failures that are environmental on
this machine (missing Playwright browser binaries; `EPERM: fsync` in the
worktree for the AGC SMS tests) and unrelated to this change.

**Not verified on a HarmonyOS device** (no build/device available here), so no
screenshot/recording is attached. Please run the ArkTS check and a device smoke
test before merge.

items.body:
Closes #242。与 #235 的状态栏内容重叠是另一类问题，本 PR 只处理 Beebou 形象浮层。

## 问题

收起态的 Beebou 是页面 `Stack` 上的绝对定位浮层：头像 `x: '50%'`、名字胶囊 `width('100%')` 居中、提醒气泡居中，三层都在 `topInset` 附近的阅读区上方。列表顶部的占位只在滚到顶部时生效，一旦上滑（#242 截图就是把用户提问滚到最上层再看），消息就从这三层底下穿过，用户无法核对自己刚发的内容。名字胶囊还是整条横幅的点击区，顶部这条横带被它拦截。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/Index.ets`
- 收起态头像**贴右边缘停靠**：`x: '100%'` + `translate(-52)`，82vp 的盒子里 52vp 可见，其余出屏；可见条同时是点击区（≥44vp 触控标准）。徽标改到可见侧，避免跑到屏外。打开实时活动面板时仍回到面板原来居中的位置（面板里 `Blank().height(72)` 早已为它留位）。
- 删除常驻居中的「Beebou」胶囊。名字 + 进度文案改为**只在 `petCaption()` 非空时**出现的小胶囊，停在头像左侧，外层 Row 用 `HitTestMode.Transparent`，不再拦截顶部按钮；点按进实时活动、长按看进展的行为保留。
- 提醒气泡从屏幕中间移到头像下方右侧边缘，仍可 × 关闭（临时提示）。
- `digitalmate-live-activity` 这个 id 移到头像容器上，`DM-WF-BACK-01` 的选择器不变。

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/OrbitPetAvatar.ets`
- 空闲时**隔一会动一会**：以静帧为主，每 4–9s 抖动 1.4s（200ms 交叉淡化），三张图常驻挂载避免换源闪动；`aboutToDisappear` 清定时器；`reduceMotion` 仍只用静帧；任务执行中保持连续播放（进度信号）。

## 验证

- 新增 `tests/unit/orbit-pet-dock.test.mjs`：停靠位置、身份胶囊不再横跨顶部且点击不被拦截、空闲抖动节律（用假定时器跑组件真实分支）。三个用例在 main 源码上全部失败，本分支全部通过。
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`：2144 个用例，2130 通过；7 个失败均为本机环境原因（缺 `playwright`、`EPERM: fsync`），与改动无关。
- **未验证**：本机没有 HarmonyOS SDK/hvigor，未做 ArkTS 编译，也没有真机/模拟器截图，视觉与手感需要在设备上确认。

## 已知取舍

顶部横带（抽屉按钮、标题所在）本来就是内容从底下滚过的沉浸式设计，头像停靠在这条横带的右端：气泡正文中间完全让开了，但消息滚到最顶端时仍会从头像下方经过，与抽屉按钮一致。若 UCD 方案要求任何滚动位置都零遮挡，需要把顶部改成真正的布局区（列表不再滚到顶栏之下），属于更大的结构改动，可在此基础继续。#242 的评论提到 UCD 方案还在跟进，允许的话请一并确认方向。

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind test

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Nightly Simulator E2E 目前只把 `DM-WF-CHAT-01` 的**执行状态**当门禁，AI 评分是 informational（`REQUIRE_AI_SCORE=false`）。因此像下面这些已经修过、但只在截图/`ui/*.json` 里才能看出来的 DigitalMate 对话缺陷，回归时不会被任何确定性门禁拦住。

新增 `tests/e2e/workflow/conversation-gate.mjs`：E2E 跑完后直接读已有证据（`run.json` + `ui/*.json` 的 `visibleTexts` / 节点 `clickable` / disclosure 节点 id），做确定性检查，不占设备时间、不依赖模型评分。

| 规则 | 级别 | 来源 issue | 检查内容 | 证据面 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `internal-payload` | 阻塞 | #306 #256 | 正文不得出现 `Next:`/`Reminder:` JSON、`orbit_*`/`mcp_*` 工具名、`agent_id` 等协议字段 | UI 文本 |
| `transport-leak` | 阻塞 | #138 #136 | 正文不得出现 `wss://`、`UNAUTHORIZED`/`ETIMEDOUT` 等传输错误、V8/Python 堆栈 | UI 文本 |
| `runtime-diagnostic` | 阻塞 | #234 | 正文不得出现子代理搜索指令、`openai-codex` / 终端 `pip install` 等沙箱运行时诊断 | UI 文本 |
| `stale-no-reply-hint` | 阻塞 | #218 | `COMPLETED` 用例不得残留「没有得到可用回复」气泡 | UI 文本 |
| `ai-disclosure` | 阻塞 | #125 | 进入过对话页的 `COMPLETED` 用例必须出现「内容由 AI 生成」 | UI 文本或 `digitalmate-ai-disclosure` 节点 |
| `bare-source-domain` | 提示 | #305 #326 | 来源不得是整段不可点击的裸域名；`--strict` 时升级为阻塞 | UI 节点 `text` + `clickable` |

接入方式：

- `nightly.yml`：在 `Build E2E report` 之前跑 `Conversation gate`，任一条阻塞规则失败即让 job 失败；`Enforce chat-01 execution gate` 改名为 `Enforce nightly gate`，notice 里带上 `gateBasis`。
- `nightly-report.mjs`：读取 `conversation-gate.json`，把结论折进 `gatePass`（`gateBasis` 变为 `execution+conversation`），用例表新增 `Conversation` 列，`nightly-summary.md` 里直接引用违规原文，`nightly-result.json` 增加 `conversationGate` / 每条用例的 `conversation`。
- 结果同时落盘为 `<run-dir>/conversation-gate.{json,md}`，随 `e2e-nightly-*` artifact 保留；本地可复跑：
  `node tests/e2e/workflow/conversation-gate.mjs --run-dir artifacts/e2e-workflow/<runId>`。
- 某条用例如果本来就要渲染内部错误，在脚本顶部 `EXEMPT` 里按用例 id 显式列出规则，不放宽全局规则。

本提交相对首版额外补上 `#234`（有验证截图与合入修复），并标明 UI dump 证据面；其余仍留给后续缺口清单合并，避免弱规则抢跑。

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes #234
Fixes #306
Fixes #218

Fixes #305

Fixes #136
Refs #256

items.body:
## Summary

The phone now has a configurable, fail-closed path to report the device-observed half of the
`#production-metrics` data, and the personal-agent service has an opt-in receiver that stores it
separately from the Gateway's production snapshot.

- **Outbox** (`cloud-adapter`: `DigitalMateClientMetrics.ets`): bounded in-memory queue of
  finalized turns, deduped by `trace_id`, with the board's per-call fields
  (`model`, `status`, `duration_ms`, `ttft_ms`, `tpot_ms`, token counts, `stream`). Cloud
  `task.profiling` model calls are attached by `task_id`, either before or after the local turn
  finalizes.
- **Reporter** (`entry`: `DigitalMateTelemetryReporter.ets`): HTTPS POST with the current Gateway
  session token and CA, 5 s debounce, exponential backoff, redirect refusal, bounded response.
  Missing endpoint, `401/403/404/405/501` and a rejected payload never enter the chat path.
- **Context**: trajectory now records coarse `region` (system region, e.g. `CN`) and `timezone`
  (`Asia/Shanghai`) plus `client_sent_at_ms`; no location permission, IP, SSID or device identifier.
- **Runtime**: `DigitalMateTaskRuntime` enables reporting from local config and stops it on logout;
  both turn and model-call reporting stay behind the existing “性能记录” opt-in.
- **Receiver** (`harness/personal-agent` `agent_bridge`): opt-in `POST /digitalmate/telemetry`
  that validates the contract and writes only normalized fields to a per-deployment SQLite store.

## Wire contract

`POST` JSON body, schema `digitalmate-client-metrics@1`, scope **`client-observed`**:

```json
{"schema":"digitalmate-client-metrics@1","scope":"client-observed",
 "environment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0","generated_at_ms":1762300000000,
 "turns":[{"trace_id":"tr-1-...","task_id":"task-...","request_id":"digitalmate-...",
   "action":"room.message","outcome":"completed","network_type":"wifi",
   "app_version":"x.y.z","region":"CN","timezone":"Asia/Shanghai",
   "message_chars":12,"started_at_ms":0,"client_sent_at_ms":0,"ended_at_ms":0,
   "attempts":1,"request_bytes":0,"response_bytes":0,
   "timings":{"tap_ms":0,"queued_ms":0,"dequeued_ms":0,"wire_send_ms":0,
              "ack_ms":0,"first_text_ms":0,"last_text_ms":0,
              "task_done_ms":0,"display_done_ms":0},
   "model_calls":[{"model":"DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017","status":"ok",
     "duration_ms":1200,"ttft_ms":300,"tpot_ms":12.5,
     "input_tokens":900,"output_tokens":120,"total_tokens":1020,"stream":true}]}]}
```

No message text, attachments, prompt/response content, credentials or local identifiers are sent.

## Receiver

`server_engine/engine_client_telemetry.py`, mounted from `create_app` only when the deployment sets
a directory:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` | Enables the route and holds `client-observed.sqlite3`; unset means no route (the fail-closed client stops). |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS` | Retention for `received_at_ms`, default 30, clamped to 1..365. |
| `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` | Enables the aggregate-only read route for the dashboard collector; unset means that route is 404. |

- Authorization mirrors `/digitalmate/ws`: Gateway mode requires a Bearer token and validates the
  Origin, and refuses `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` scoped credentials; otherwise `authorize_client`
  applies (loopback or `DIGITALMATE_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
- Strict validation: schema/scope, ≤20 turns per batch, ≤32 model calls per turn, ≤256 KiB body.
  Unknown keys are dropped, never stored; there is no path from a device field into
  `classified-production`.
- Idempotent by `(trace_id, task_id, request_id, started_at_ms)`, so a retried batch writes once and
  two devices whose local counters coincide cannot overwrite each other. Writes are normalized
  columns plus JSON; the raw request body is never kept.
- A client-claimed `environment` is **untrusted** and stored only as `client_environment` for
  diagnosis; the deployment identity is the store directory. Write failure → `503` (the device
  retries); invalid batch → `400` (the device drops it). An unwritable directory logs a warning and
  leaves the product service running without metrics.

### Aggregate read for the dashboard

Setting `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN` mounts `GET /digitalmate/telemetry/summary?days=N`
(default 7 days, clamped to the retention window). It accepts **only** that deployment secret
(constant-time compare) and refuses device `digitalmate-tool.`/`orp_` credentials, so a device
credential never reads aggregates. The response, `client-observed-aggregate@1`:

- `turns`/`outcomes`/`networks` — turn count, completion and network mix;
- `client_ttft` — click-to-first-text duration (count/avg/p50/p95);
- `end_to_end` — click-to-rendered duration;
- `segments` — the eight stages derived from consecutive client marks;
- `models` — calls, successes, streamed calls, TTFT/TPOT distributions and token sums per model.

It contains no `trace_id`, `task_id`, `request_id`, message content or client-claimed
environment label; the dashboard collector labels each deployment from its own configuration.

## Local configuration (never committed)

`app_config.json` → `digitalmate`:

```json
{"telemetryUrl":"https://<same host as url>/digitalmate/telemetry",
 "telemetryEnvironment":"adx-jiuwen-test-0"}
```

`telemetryUrl` absent disables reporting. Cross-host, plain-HTTP, query or fragment URLs and
malformed environment labels are rejected at startup by both the app and `sync-app-config.mjs`.
No token from the test-environment announcement is stored in the repository; each device keeps
using the Gateway login credential it already has.

## Trust boundary

Device data is advisory only. It is sent as `client-observed` and must never be merged into the
trusted `classified-production` snapshot, which continues to come exclusively from LiteLLM
`/spend/logs/v2` with `traffic_type=production`. `request_id` is included for correlation only and
must be stripped from any published dashboard snapshot.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-client-metrics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-telemetry-reporter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-trajectory.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-config.test.mjs tests/unit/sync-app-config.test.mjs` — 49 passed.
- Related suites (`digitalmate-notifications`, `digitalmate-stop-control`, `digitalmate-task-runtime-memory`, `digitalmate-shared-binding`, `digitalmate-device-st`, `digitalmate-profiling`, `digitalmate-gateway-auth`) — 156 passed.
- `pytest tests/test_client_telemetry.py` (personal-agent `agent_bridge`) — 21 passed, covering
  normalization, idempotency, retention, the 404/400/413/403/202 route behaviour, Gateway and
  private auth modes, the unwritable-directory fallback, and the aggregate's TTFT/segment/model
  arithmetic, window, privacy and export-token behaviour.
- Four pre-existing failures in `test_bridge.py`, `test_bridge_startup_imports.py` and
  `test_bridge_shutdown.py` on this branch are unrelated (`Bridge.dispatch_guest` and
  `_claude_hooks` do not exist here; one fixture needs `server_engine` installed).
- Full `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` is not fully runnable in this worktree: tests that need
  the untracked `node_modules` (`typescript`, `playwright`) fail on `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`
  independently of this change.
- No device build, live upload, deployment to the five test environments or production validation
  has been performed.

## Dashboard side

Companion PR: `agent-CI-Infra/dashboard#28`. It reads the aggregate into a separate
`client-observed-metrics@1` file and a separate 「端侧观测」 tab: KPI tiles, end-to-end segment
bars, an environment comparison table and a model comparison table with an environment selector.
It shares no file, schema or rendering path with the `classified-production` view, publishes no
identifiers or message content, and labels environments from the deployment configuration rather
than from device claims. A deployment that cannot be read on a run reuses its last record marked
as a historical snapshot.

## Still required

1. Deploy the receiver to the test environments with `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_DIR` and
   `DIGITALMATE_TELEMETRY_EXPORT_TOKEN`, and verify the phone → store → dashboard path end to end.
2. Merge the companion dashboard change.

Keep this PR in **draft** until the receiver is deployed and verified end to end.

items.body:
Fixes #567

## 改了什么（生产 +2 / −0，一个文件）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/SkillCenter/Detail.ets`

- `:465` `Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch, isOn: this.enabledState })` → 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')`（名字落在 `:466`；`Toggle` 在 base `48435d43` 与 head 都是 `:465`）；
- `:471` `Text('···')`（base 上是 `:470`，本 PR 在它上方插了一行后为 `:471`；`.bindMenu(this.overflowActions())` 在 `:476`）→ 修饰链加 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`（名字落在 `:475`）。

两处都照仓库既有写法，不新增约定：`pages/A2uiHome/components/TrainPresalePanel.ets:1061`（同型开关带 `.accessibilityText('授权提交真实未支付订单')`）、`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets:3075`（`.accessibilityText('更多操作 ' + file.name).bindMenu(...)`）。

## 用户问题

技能详情页（`main_pages.json:10` 注册，`SkillCenterView.ets:29` 经 `router.pushUrl` 进入，渲染条件 `this.phase === 'ready'`，无 debug 闸门）顶部两个控件没有可读名：开关只播报「开关，开 / 关」，`···` 被念成「点 点 点」。`···` 是「发布到技能市场」「卸载」的唯一入口，读屏用户因此找不到卸载入口，也判断不出开关在控制什么。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs`（当前 head 上 187 行；红 commit `bb5c0f70` 上是首版 176 行，`626e5d20` 按评审 F1 放宽了 `Text('···')` 定位器的引号）。它复用 `scripts/check-a11y.mjs` 导出的 `stripComments` 与自写的链扫描，把名字断言在**该控件自己的修饰链**上——写在文件别处不能糊弄过去；同时断言两个定位点各只有 1 处、仍在 `if (this.phase === 'ready')` 块内、且没有互相借用名字。不依赖网络与 ArkTS SDK。

```
红基线 bb5c0f70（只有测试）: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2
  ✖ the enable switch is named 启用该技能 on its own chain
  ✖ the overflow trigger is named 更多操作 on the chain that opens the menu
修复后 626e5d20:            tests 3 / pass 3 / fail 0
用最终测试文件在 48435d43 上重跑: tests 3 / pass 1 / fail 2（同两条红名，与红基线一致）
node --test tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs → tests 22 / pass 22 / fail 0
node scripts/check-a11y.mjs → Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.
git diff bb5c0f70 74376ff3 -- tests/unit/skillcenter-detail-a11y.test.mjs → 空（红→修之间测试文件未动）
626e5d20 是评审后的一条 test-only 跟进：git diff --quiet 74376ff3 626e5d20 -- '*.ets' → PROD-UNCHANGED，只让 locator 同时接受 '···' 与 "···" 两种引号（评审 F1：避免格式化后误报「控件不存在」而不是「名字不对」）。
```

`check-a11y` 数字不变是预期：门禁的 `UNNAMEABLE` 只含容器与裸形状，`Toggle` 与作为可点目标的 `Text` 不在其中；`--json` 上该文件仍是 `taps 11 / unnamed 4`，总数 28，`violations []`、`stale []`。

## 回归护栏（变异验证，都在本分支实跑）

| 变异 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| M1 删掉 Toggle 的 `.accessibilityText('启用该技能')` | 1 红（switch 断言） |
| M2 删掉 `Text('···')` 的 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')` | 1 红（overflow 断言） |
| M3 把 `'更多操作'` 改成 `'更多'` | 1 红（overflow 断言） |
| M4 把 Toggle 的名字挪到 `Text('···')` 的链上 | 2 红（两条断言各自抓住，证明测的是节点不是字符串） |
| M5 源码里 `Text('···')` 改成 `Text("···")`（名字仍在） | 3/3 绿（locator 容忍另一种引号，说明 F1 的修法是放宽 locator、不是删断言） |
| M6 同上改双引号且删掉名字 | 1 红，报「必须带 `.accessibilityText('更多操作')`」，不是「找不到控件」 |

每次变异后还原并复跑 3/3 绿；每次回读被改行逐字符确认只动了预期字符。

## 未纳入本 PR

`Detail.ets` 另有 4 个无名可点目标（`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs --json` 实测：该文件 11 个可点、4 个无名，`heads` 为 `Stack`/`Stack`/`Row`/`Stack`），属于 `tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 里已复核的既有基线债务；本轮**不动基线**（该文件被 open PR #551 占用，另 #557 也改它），也不在本 PR 修这 4 处。基线文件本身就是这份债务的台账。

## 评审跟进

## 做了什么

主屏任务浮层 `WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的三个可点控件，父节点都有 `.accessibilityText(...)` 标签，但**父节点内部的纯装饰图标**没标 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，读屏念完标签后会紧接着再停一个「图片/符号」（ArkUI 里 `.accessibilityText` 不合并子树）。同文件另外三处（`statusIcon()` 的两个图标、预览行的 `chevron_down`）已经标了 `'no'`，所以这是漏标，不是新规矩。

本 PR 只补三处，不动布局、尺寸、文案、`onClick`：

- 收起按钮里的 `SymbolGlyph($r('sys.symbol.xmark'))`
- 结果摘要行里的旋转箭头 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`
- 继续追问按钮里的 `Image($r('app.media.arrow_up'))`

因为这三个图标没有 `onClick`，不属于 `check-a11y` 的 unnamed tap target，`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` **一行未改**。

## Reachability（release 路径）

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:9244` 实例化 `WaterfallTaskOverlay({...})`，随 A2uiHome 首页渲染；任务执行中/结束时浮层出现在主屏上方。整条链上没有任何 debug 闸门或 build 变量开关。

## 证据

**红（pristine `3802d46e`，干净 worktree，只放本 PR 的测试文件）**

```
$ git worktree add --detach pristine 3802d46e
$ cp tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs pristine/tests/unit/
$ cd pristine && node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 7 · pass 4 · fail 3
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
  AssertionError: the sheet close button: its SymbolGlyph child at line 164 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'),
  so the screen reader announces a bare symbolglyph right after the wrapper label
✖ the result summary row hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the result summary row: its Image child at line 182 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
✖ the follow-up send button hides its decorative arrow
  AssertionError: the follow-up send button: its Image child at line 197 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), …
exit=1
```

这三条是「缺 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`」的断言失败，不是节点没定位到（每条都回显了它切到的节点与行号）。红证据所在的提交是 `dc93bd821eb75dfab88661329abf2432f698bce4`（本分支第一个 commit，只含测试文件），该 commit 在 fork 上可直接取。

**绿（本 PR head）**

```
$ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0   exit=0

$ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs tests/unit/a11y-gate.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-task-card-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 34 · pass 34 · fail 0
```

**载重（变异检查）**

```
# M0 修复后
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
# M1 只删掉 xmark 那行的 .accessibilityLevel('no')
✖ the sheet close button hides its decorative xmark glyph
ℹ tests 7 · pass 6 · fail 1
# M2 还原
ℹ tests 7 · pass 7 · fail 0
```

**gate**

```
$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs
Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.   exit=0
```

修复前后都是这条（这三个图标不是 tap target），`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json` 未改动。

## 改动范围

- 允许改（本 PR 实际改动）：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets`、新增 `tests/unit/waterfall-task-overlay-a11y.test.mjs`。
- 禁止改（本 PR 未触碰）：`scripts/check-a11y.mjs`、`scripts/ci/*`、任何 `tests/st/*`、`tests/unit/a11y-baseline.json`、`pages/CloudHome/SessionDrawer.ets`（仍由 open PR #551 占用），以及其它被 open PR 占用的文件。
- 基于 `3802d46e`，改动 2 文件、`+207 / −1`（其中生产代码 +3/−1）。

## 风险与回滚

- 风险：low。只加三个无障碍属性，无逻辑分支、无数据/网络/权限改动，不改变布局与命中区。
- 回滚：`git revert 4efccba`（或整分支关闭），无数据迁移。
- 未覆盖：沙箱无 ArkTS SDK、无真机，**没有在设备上录过 TalkBack/VoiceOver 的实际播报顺序**；结论来自源码级静态断言 + ArkUI `.accessibilityText` / `.accessibilityLevel` 的语义。真机上若发现图标仍被朗读，需要补一次设备核对。

Fixes #558

## 评审与风险

- Reviewer：**92/100，不阻塞可合**（COMMENT 已发：评论 `6628399167`；本环境无独立 reviewer 身份，评论由 Lead 用实现账号代发并在正文注明 self-review disclosure；未 approve、未 merge）。
- Security：**risk: low**（评论 `6628373046`）：只新增 3 个无障碍属性，无新 import/网络/存储/权限；`accessibilityLevel('no')` 只移出组件自身，不影响父节点标签与 onClick；被隐藏的都是纯装饰叶子图标，没有把 `task.prompt` / `task.reply` 拼进朗读文本。
- Test：独立在 pristine `3802d46e` 上跑出 `4 pass / 3 fail`，另做三段变异（评论 `6628351969`）。

items.body:
## What

Every self-hosted gate job now resolves `runs-on` from a `RUNNER_*` repository variable, keeping the current labels as a literal fallback:

```yaml
runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNER_CI_NODE_UT || '["self-hosted","Linux","X64","dm-nodeut"]') }}
```

Changing which machine runs a job no longer needs a workflow edit or a pull request. Setting the variable applies to the next workflow run; jobs already running keep their assigned runner.

This branch now includes `main` after #526 consolidated `ut.yml` into `ci.yml`; the routing catalog follows the new `node-ut` / `hypium-ut` / `st` / `gate-report` jobs.

## Changes

- `.github/ci-runners.json`: job → variable → default-label catalog for all 15 self-hosted jobs.
- `scripts/ci-runners.mjs`: `list`, `set`, `reset`, `apply`; supports dry-run, comma lists, JSON arrays and runner groups.
- Converted `ci.yml` (`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `st`, `gate-report`), `code-check.yml`, `server-regression.yml`, `eval.yml`, `nightly.yml` and `bench.yml`. GitHub-hosted jobs are unchanged.
- `tests/unit/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`: keeps each workflow fallback in sync with the catalog, and covers the CLI against a mock Actions variables API.
- `docs/developer_guide/ci.md`: usage, caveats and the full variable table.
- **Also:** `Eval contract (replay)` no longer runs on pull requests. The replay fixtures validate the eval harness, not the product, and its `actions/checkout` step repeatedly timed out on the self-hosted runner. It remains available on pushes to main (eval paths) and `workflow_dispatch`. Covered by a unit test so the PR trigger does not come back.

## Usage

```bash
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs list
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs set ci_node_ut self-hosted,Linux,X64,dm-utility
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs apply /tmp/runner-routing.json
node scripts/ci-runners.mjs reset --all
```

## Behavior and caveats

- With no variables set, behavior is unchanged: every default is the label set that was hard-coded before.
- Changing a default still needs a PR; switching machines does not.
- `pull_request_target` workflows execute the default branch's workflow file, so the runner-routing mechanism becomes effective on PRs once this merges.
- The target runner must already carry the configured labels (or belong to the named runner group).
- Changing variables needs repository admin; `--dry-run` previews the plan.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`: 2526 tests, 2524 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed (after merging main).
- `actionlint` on the changed workflows: no new findings (only pre-existing shellcheck warnings).
- YAML parse check on all workflow files and `.github/ci-runners.json`.

items.body:
Fixes #521

## What this changes

`deepSearchSourceHost()` in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlHomeRenderer.ets` (`HTML_HOME_JS`, `:3749-3771`) derives the domain label rendered next to every deep-search citation (`:3856`). It used to strip the scheme and cut at the first `/`, so the label kept the URL userinfo, the port, the query string and the fragment:

```
https://alice:pw@example.com/a   ->  alice:pw@example.com   (rendered as the site name)
https://user@www.paypal.com/     ->  user@www.paypal.com
https://example.com?q=1          ->  example.com?q=1
https://example.com:8443/x       ->  example.com:8443
http://[::1]:8080/x              ->  [::1]:8080
```

The function now parses the authority in a single character pass: it ends at the first `/`, `?`, `#` **or `\`**, and TAB/LF/CR are dropped instead of being kept in the label (that is what a browser does with whitespace inside a URL). After that the userinfo is dropped at the last `@`, and the port is dropped, except that an IPv6 literal keeps its brackets. The scheme test is case-insensitive, and an empty or non-http(s) input yields `''` instead of the raw value.

Only this one function changed. `openWaterfallSource()` (`:3861`), the click path and the `title || url` fallback at `:3855` are untouched.

## Red first

```
cd <tree at upstream main 1432414e> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 6
ℹ fail 14
```

Six positive cases stay green there, so the red is the assertions and not a broken load. The test slices the shipped `text()` and `deepSearchSourceHost()` out of the real `.ets` (brace matching that skips string literals and comments), strips the types and runs both in a `vm` context — no copy of the implementation and no assertion on the source text.

## Green on the head

```
cd <tree at 55df4a9a> && node --test tests/unit/deep-search-source-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 20
ℹ pass 20
ℹ fail 0
```

Related page baseline: `tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` `1/1`.

Whole `tests/unit` suite, same checkout pair (measured on the 17-case revision of this branch, `d45838c1`):

| tree | tests | pass | fail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| main `1432414e` | 1699 | 1657 | 35 |
| head `d45838c1` | 1716 | 1674 | 35 |

The difference is exactly the new cases, and the failing set is byte-for-byte the same 28 files on both sides — all of them stop at `Cannot find module 'typescript'` / `'playwright'`, which this sandbox does not install and CI does.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` raised one finding (F1, medium): the authority scan stopped only at `/`, `?` and `#`, so a crafted citation could label a host the click does not open — `https://evil.test\@example.com/x` was labelled `example.com`, and `https://example.com\@evil.test/` was labelled `evil.test`.

Fixed in two commits on this branch:

- `bac3c5a2` — adds the three cases (both `\@` directions, plus a TAB inside the host), test file only.
- `55df4a9a` — the scan now also breaks on `\` (char code 92) and skips TAB/LF/CR (9/10/13).

Verified against the previous head with the same 20-case file:

```
cd <tree at d45838c1>        ℹ tests 20  pass 17  fail 3
cd <tree at 55df4a9a>        ℹ tests 20  pass 20  fail 0
```

The three red cases on `d45838c1` are exactly the F1 cases, so the new assertions pin the gap rather than restating the fix.

## Mutation

Each mutation is one edit to the shipped `.ets`; the test file is unchanged.

| mutation | result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 — delete the two userinfo lines | `20 / 16 / 4` |
| M2 — remove the `\` break (char code 92) | `20 / 18 / 2` |
| M3 — remove the TAB/LF/CR skip | `20 / 19 / 1` |

Restoring each edit returns `20/20`. The four M1 reds are the userinfo cases, the two M2 reds are the `\@` cases, the single M3 red is the TAB case — so every branch of the rewrite is pinned by an assertion instead of being dead code.

## Not covered here

- `deepSearchSourceTitle` at `:3855` (`text(source && source.title) || url`) still falls back to the whole URL when a source has no title. That is a citation-title decision, not the host label, and it is left for a follow-up.
- A percent-encoded `%5c` in the authority is kept in the label as-is; such a URL does not open, so the label fails closed.
- The upstream source filter at `:3850` compares the scheme case-insensitively only in this function; a `HTTPS://…` source never reaches it today because the filter above is case-sensitive.

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Dev-1 · implemented</sub>

items.body:
Refs #505. This PR covers the initial removal and module relocation phase of the broader backend refactoring plan. Class-level decomposition and delivery acceptance remain tracked by the RFC.

This PR targets the new `refactor/backend` integration branch, created at `8cc72139`. App connection implementations are retained. The `main` branch is unchanged.

DigitalMate business tasks now select one primary Agent. Product Teams, independent Agent delegation, cross-Agent review, Agent handoff and automatic Agent relay within a room are removed. WorkSwarm's executor-internal subagents, user questions, tool approvals, App connections and human collaboration remain available.

### Changes

- Replace business delegation with `user.ask` for questions to the user. The legacy `agent.ask` action accepts only the user/person recipient. Historical Team/delegation records remain readable but cannot execute, resume, reroute into active work or reuse a Team session.
- Keep internal subagent events separate from the primary reply. A child's completion or error cannot prematurely close the main stream; normal primary completion and errors still settle the task.
- Move the product backend to `backend/src/digitalmate_backend/{server,application,harness,workspace,memory,source,contracts,shared,adapters}`. Extract shared record/ID primitives and the location contract, update imports and package resources, and add import-boundary checks.
- Split wire types/resources into `packages/protocol`; `packages/core` keeps client helpers and depends on protocol. Update deployment, startup, packaging and CI paths.
- Move pinned WorkSwarm and agent-core sources to `vendor`. All **2,771 + 2,894 source files, Git object IDs and executable modes match the existing manifests**. The platform implementation is unchanged.
- Remove hidden phone Team entries and background Team recommendations. There is no new visible page or layout.

### Review guide and scope

The first commit removes behavior in the original layout; the second establishes the module layout. Most changed files are byte-identical vendor moves. See `docs/developer_guide/backend-modules.md` for responsibilities and `backend-module-map.csv` for old/new file locations and extraction reasons.

This is the deletion and initial module migration step. `EngineService`, models colocated with `EngineStore`, and grouped stage records remain explicit migration facades; this PR does not claim their full class-level decomposition. No plugin loader or JiuwenSwarm plugin integration is introduced. Existing database transaction boundaries and memory coordination are retained.

### Validation

- Migrated business regression selection: **447 passed, 132 subtests passed, 4 deselected**.
- Credential-free server/fake Gateway regression runner: **55 tests passed**.
- Primary-Agent boundaries, historical workflow rejection, artifacts and installable package tests: **59 passed, 9 subtests passed**.
- Location/artifact/room/primary-Agent regression selection: **56 passed**.
- `npm run typecheck` and Core tests: **24 passed**; focused phone skill tests: **18 passed**.
- Vendor/deployment path tests: **12 passed**; runtime wheel contracts: **4 passed**; import-linter: **3 contracts kept**.
- Backend wheel built from the final local project; imports and packaged resources verified from an extracted wheel outside the source tree. Vendor source verification and staged object/mode comparison passed. `git diff --check` passed.

Validation uses temporary local stores and fake Gateways. No live model, container deployment or phone-device acceptance was run. The inherited full Python suite is not green at base `8cc72139` (obsolete executor/settings fixtures and optional SDK dependencies); the focused suites above are the verified scope. Two pre-existing undefined-name findings remain in `_history_directory_key` (`project_key_for_directory`) and `_gate_confirm` (`device_change_arguments`), reproduced on the clean upstream baseline.

### Follow-up validation

At head `f9b04e47`, the HarmonyOS package built successfully and was installed in a separate local emulator; startup reached the login screen. Workflow contracts passed 14/14 and workflow-driver unit tests passed 51/51. No Nightly E2E case ran, no refactored cloud backend was deployed, and this does not establish end-to-end acceptance.

items.body:
## What this fixes

`popupTitleFromUrl()` decided the popup title by searching the **whole URL** for provider names (`indexOf('google')`, `indexOf('paypal')`, `indexOf('checkout.stripe.com/')`, `indexOf('alipay')`), and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` then gave every non-neutral title the subtitle **`安全确认页面`**. A page could therefore borrow a provider label with a longer domain label, a userinfo authority, a path or a query string, while the popup has no address bar to correct it:

```
https://notpaypal.com/                       -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://paypal.com:443@evil.test/checkout    -> "PayPal 确认"     / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/?ref=google                -> "Google Pay 确认" / "安全确认页面"
https://evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x  -> "支付确认"        / "安全确认页面"
```

Fixes #518.

## Change

One function in `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: parse the authority, reject anything that is not `http(s)`, has userinfo, is an IPv6 literal or ends with a dot, strip the port, then name a provider only when `host === domain || host.endsWith('.' + domain)`. The Google Maps branch keeps both the `maps.google.com` host and the `google.com` + `/maps/` path form; `checkout.stripe.com` stays an exact host. `popupSubtitleFromTitle()`, `shouldOpenWaterfallSourceExternally()` and the three call sites (`:181`, `:238`, `:832`) are untouched.

## Commits (4, two files, +174/−5)

1. `1460f3df` — test only (+142): slices `popupTitleFromUrl()` and `popupSubtitleFromTitle()` out of the shipped ArkTS file and executes them; red on unmodified `main`.
2. `ce401058` — the fix (+21/−5).
3. `cac7ba8b` — test only (+5): the first mutation run showed the userinfo guard was **not load-bearing**. `https://www.paypal.com@evil.test/checkout` fell back to the neutral title even with the `@` check deleted, because the allowlist alone rejects a host that still contains `@`. The case that does depend on the check is a userinfo authority **with a port**: port stripping runs after the userinfo test, so `paypal.com:443@evil.test` reduces to `paypal.com` and is labelled `PayPal 确认` again. Commit 3 pins both port forms, and deleting `authority.indexOf(@) >= 0` now fails exactly those two cases.
4. `3a3cb666` — follow-up after the bot review (+5 test, +2/−1 code): reject a backslash in the authority.

## Follow-up fix after bot review

`agent-ci-infra-bot` flagged that a special URL scheme rewrites `\` to `/`, so `https://evil.test\.paypal.com/` opens `evil.test` while the raw authority still ends with `.paypal.com` — the popup said `PayPal 确认`; `https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x` said `Google Maps 路线` the same way. The repository already rejects such addresses in `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (`[^/?#@\s\\]+`), so this file was looser than the existing policy.

The authority now also has to be free of backslashes before any provider is named. All three backslash shapes are pinned: on the previous head (`cac7ba8b`) the first two were red and `https://paypal.com\.evil.test/` was already neutral; it stays neutral, because the function does not model the backslash rewrite, it just refuses the shape.

## Evidence (all from a full unpack of `main` at `9cd6dc62`; the branch blobs match the API sha1)

```
# red: unmodified main tree + the final test file
node --test tests/unit/home-popup-title-host.test.mjs
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 3  ℹ fail 16

# green: head 3a3cb666 tree (same blobs)
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 19  ℹ fail 0

# red on the previous head cac7ba8b, before the backslash guard
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2
✖ https://evil.test\.paypal.com/          actual "PayPal 确认"      expected "内容详情"
✖ https://evil.test\.google.com/maps/x    actual "Google Maps 路线" expected "内容详情"

# M2 on 3a3cb666: delete the @ check
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 17  ℹ fail 2   (the two port-userinfo cases)

# M3 on 3a3cb666: host.endsWith('.paypal.com') -> host.endsWith('paypal.com')
ℹ tests 19  ℹ pass 18  ℹ fail 1   (https://notpaypal.com/)
```

The 16 red cases on `main` are the look-alike hosts (including `notpaypal.com`, `google.com.evil.test`, both port-userinfo forms, the backslash forms and `evil.test/checkout.stripe.com/pay/x`); the 3 passing ones are the real-provider reverse guard, the subtitle mapping guard and `https://evil.test/#checkout.stripe.com`, which is already neutral on `main` and is kept as a guard next to its red variant.

## Known behaviour change

`https://user@www.paypal.com/` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: any address carrying userinfo is now neutral. This is deliberate — the reader cannot see the userinfo, and the popup has no address bar.

- `https://checkout.stripe.com` (no path) changes from `内容详情` to `支付确认`: matching the exact host is wider than the old substring `checkout.stripe.com/`.
- `https://foo.checkout.stripe.com/pay` changes from `支付确认` to `内容详情`: subdomains of the checkout host are no longer accepted.
- `https://paypal.me/someone` changes from `PayPal 确认` to `内容详情`: the old substring match accepted the `paypal` token anywhere, and `paypal.me` is a different registrable domain. It is a genuine PayPal link domain, so adding it to the allowlist is a follow-up decision.
- `https://gpay.app/x` changes from `Google Pay 确认` to `内容详情`: `gpay.app` is not a Google host, so the old label was wrong; it now falls back to the neutral title.
- `https://paypal.com\` and `https://paypal.com\@evil.test/` fall back to `内容详情` even though a browser would open `paypal.com`: the contract is "any authority containing a backslash is neutral". The function refuses the shape instead of modelling the `\`-to-`/` rewrite, which is the conservative direction.

## Not covered here

- `https://evil.test%5c.paypal.com/` (percent-encoded backslash) still resolves to `PayPal 确认`: WHATWG decodes `%5C` inside the host, which makes the address invalid, so the popup loads nothing (fail-closed). Rejecting `%5c` case-insensitively in the authority would close it; recorded as a follow-up rather than added to this minimal fix.

- `https://www.google.com/search?q=1` keeps `Google Pay 确认 / 安全确认页面` before and after: the mapping is host-level, not path-level, and tightening it beyond the maps branch is a separate decision. `https://www.google.com/maps?q=1` and `https://www.google.com/maps` (path `/maps`, without the trailing slash) keep the same title for the same reason; that is pre-existing behaviour on `main`, not introduced here. Accepting them would take `path === '/maps' || path.startsWith('/maps/')`, which is a behaviour widening and is left for a follow-up issue.
- The popup still renders no URL or host anywhere (`popupUrl` is only assigned/loaded, never rendered as text), so the title remains the only site hint. Giving the sheet a host line is a follow-up.

## Who did what

- Issue text: Lead (Product did not deliver in this round).
- Failing test and the port-userinfo hardening: DigitalMate Test.
- Fix in `HtmlHomeSurfaceView.ets`: DigitalMate Dev-1.
- Integration, red/green/mutation runs and this PR: Lead.

<sub>Fledge · DigitalMate · Dev-1 · implemented</sub>

items.body: ## What The aggregate-search renderer treated any `http(s)` address as a valid source, so `https://a.com@evil.test/y` rendered as a clickable source button and as the "打开原文" preview, while the WebView/browser lands on `evil.test`. The host that receives the click was never checked. ## Fix - `validSourceUrl()` now also rejects an address whose authority carries userinfo (`url.username || url.password`). It is the single gate behind three consumers: the card source anchor, `normalizedRelatedUrl()`, and the related-image filter — including the `coverUrl` fallback, which used to bypass it. - The aggregate post preview is built outside the template by `renderPostLink()`, which wrote the row URL into `href` with no check at all (`javascript:` included). It now goes through a named `safeExternalUrl()` helper using the repository's existing predicate from `workers/WaterfallPoolWorker.ets:429` (http(s) only, no userinfo in the authority). - An `@` inside the path (`https://a.com/x@evil.test`) is not userinfo and keeps working. The template string runs in the WebView, `renderPostLink()` is ArkTS: the template function is not reachable from native code, so the **same judgement exists once per runtime, as two implementations** — not one shared implementation. The divergence is listed below. ## Files - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/HtmlAggregateSearchHomeRenderer.ets` **+12/−2** - `tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs` **+144/−0** (new independent test file; the existing `waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs` is untouched and still passes) ## Evidence Red on the unmodified `main` tree (`8cc7213`), module byte-identical to main, only the new test file added: ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ✖ validSourceUrl rejects a host that is not the one in the address bar ✖ the card source anchor is not rendered for a userinfo address ✖ normalizedRelatedUrl drops a userinfo address and keeps an ordinary one ✖ related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one ✖ the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5 ``` After the fix commits (`7ea044c8`, `4e44321e`): ``` $ node --test tests/unit/aggregate-search-link-userinfo.test.mjs ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0 $ node --test tests/unit/waterfall-renderer-interaction.test.mjs ℹ tests 1 / pass 1 / fail 0 ``` Mutation checks (each reverted afterwards): | mutation | result | |---|---| | delete `if (url.username || url.password) return false;` | 4 template blocks red, native block green | | `renderPostLink`: `safeExternalUrl(postLinkUrl(block))` → `postLinkUrl(block)` | only `the aggregate post link preview does not link to a userinfo address` red | | `relatedMarkup`: `validSourceUrl(item.coverUrl) ? … : ''` → `item.coverUrl` | only `related markup filters a userinfo image and keeps an ordinary one` red (5/4/1) | Reverse guards: `https://a.com/x`, `http://a.com`, `https://a.com/x@evil.test` stay valid and still render; `javascript:alert(1)` is rejected on both halves; an ordinary `coverUrl` still renders. ## Known residual: the two implementations diverge on 4 malformed inputs A 24-case truth table run against both shipped implementations (job output, not copied code) found 4 divergences: | input | template `validSourceUrl` | native `safeExternalUrl` | |---|---|---| | `https://@evil.test/y` | true (empty userinfo; host evil.test, label also shows evil.test) | false | | `https://a.com%40evil.test/x` | **false** (WHATWG parser rejects the invalid host) | **true** | | `https:a.com/x` | true (normalised to `https://a.com/x`) | false | | `https://a.com\@evil.test/x` | true (`\` treated as `/`, host stays a.com) | false | Three are the native half being **stricter** (a rare malformed address loses its link; the safe direction). The only looser case is `https://a.com%40evil.test/x`: the native regex accepts it, but the WebView's WHATWG parser rejects it as an invalid host and does not navigate (Node's `URL`, same spec, throws `Invalid URL`). Merging the two fully would require `@ohos.url` on the native side; out of scope here. ## Not covered here - Shared JSON corpus pinning both implementations to one list of URLs (review point 3, self-marked non-blocking): it needs a new corpus file plus both harnesses rewritten, beyond one issue / one PR → follow-up after #512. - The other `coverUrl` → `` sinks in this renderer (`:2958`, `:4791`, `:4870`, `:2913`) and `renderEmbed()`'s `embedUrl`/`thumbnail` → ``/`

The evaluation contract job can spend its entire timeout in Git checkout on the self-hosted runners. PR #501 hit repeated connection resets before its tests could start.

Download the exact source commit through the same GitHub archive route used by server regressions, allow time for a slow connection, and record that commit in the evaluation report when the archive has no Git metadata. Cap the download and all retries at 20 minutes, with a 10-second termination grace, so the 25-minute job has time for the tests and failure summary.

Refs #501.

Validation:
- [Self-hosted evaluation workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41634773393) passed on the current commit: 47 self-tests, 11 task contracts, and both replay tasks passed.
- `node --test tests/eval/eval.test.mjs tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs` (57 passed).
- Exercised the download and summary scripts with a local archive and a scaled stalled-transfer timeout; extraction succeeded and the failure summary was produced. Confirmed the total timeout also interrupts curl's retry backoff.
- Ran the self-tests, task validation, and replay tasks from a local archive without `.git` and verified the recorded commit.

E2E DAG validation compares fixed component states before and after each action, showing paired expected/actual endpoint values in HTML. Non-applicable checks are hidden. Generated reply wording, intermediate animation sequences and DAG-specific screenshots are excluded. Missing captures, invalid paths, ineffective actions and component mismatches fail the artifact gate.

One shared allowlist enables 12 reviewed cases for both CI execution and independent artifact validation. BACK-01, QUOTE-01 and TRAVEL-01 retain their standards but are deferred. ST and UT do not run application DAG/component gates.

CI validation uses the effective target consistently for job naming, simulator startup and signing checks. The dedicated upstream validation branch builds and installs the checkout on the simulator, launches it without an interactive window, and skips ST/cloud image deployment. Standard/checker tests run before device operations. The CLI resolves canonical entry paths so macOS temporary-directory symlinks cannot silently skip execution. Page preflight reuses the workflow driver's readiness checks and reports login or system-blocking conditions explicitly.

Validation:
- 40 DAG/component checker tests passed locally and on the macOS CI runner, including a symlink-entry regression.
- Remote simulator startup, device connection, native build and HAP installation passed.
- Four device/signing scenarios and two emulator-launch branches checked locally with mocked build/device executables.
- Local three-round E2E experiment (one attempt per case, frozen standards): 12/12, 1/12, 1/12. Of 22 failures, 20 showed reply failure, one showed cloud session recovery failure and one failed foreground readiness. The controlled component case passed 3/3. This does not establish stability of all business terminal-state checks.
- Latest remote run: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41620367760 . E2E execution is currently blocked because the remote simulator opens the DigitalMate login page. Authentication must be restored before rerunning; no remote E2E pass is claimed.

Readiness limit: an action boundary is captured after its driver returns and a quiet layout or completed frame. This does not independently guarantee completion of all asynchronous business work. Reply-completion readiness currently includes UI heuristics and a stable-text fallback; fixed endpoint controls are checked against the reviewed standard.
